blocks.text: Status Effects Identify common buffs, penalties, environmental effects, and combat conditions, including whether other players can see them.

blocks.html:
Certain status effects exist which do not have an icon. These have a placeholder?. One example of this are certain enemy attacks, such as the Alchemist Bowman's explosive shot. Some uncommon effects may not yet be represented in the list.

Weather is expected to have more significant impacts on players with the release of Sarducaa (heat) and Nordveld (cold). Breaching certain character temperature thresholds will give a consequence. The first tier of this is a stamina penalty. After that, the player starts to receive damage. At an even higher threshold, the damage becomes severe. Elementalism can altering the impact of heat, for better or worse. Please note that "visible" means that this status effect is identifiable by other players.

guides.title: Client Performance
guides.summary: A focused checklist for improving frame rate, reducing stutter, and testing graphics, driver, display, and hardware settings.

blocks.html:
A focused checklist for improving frame rate, reducing stutter, and testing graphics, driver, display, and hardware settings.

1. Check windows power settings. It should be set to HIGH PERFORMANCE.

  1. Set your MO2 steam launch options to: -malloc=system -USEALLAVAILABLECORES -sm4

This forces your CPU to use more cores, and allows your game to use more memory as needed. SM4 is supposed to force a lower tier of directX shaders but it may not actually do anything.

Also disable steam overlay while in game. This crushes FPS.

3. Optimize in game settings.

Almost all settings should be set to low, especially shadows, post processing, effects, and foliage. If you have a 20 series or higher Nvidia card you should have DLSS on performance quality. Tinker with the upscaling to see what setting works best for you. Effects is ideal at HIGH so that spells glow in the dark, but if peformance is really bad lower it.

The most important setting overlooked is WINDOW MODE should be set to WINDOWED-FULLSCREEN. Fullscreen only mode can lower performance.

Draw distance should be at 100%. Higher values can add load without a useful gameplay benefit.

Maintain verticle field of view is only important if you have an ultrawide monitor.

Disable VSYNC and motion blur.

Test which DLSS setting works best for you. This setting produced the best performance during testing.

4. After you have done all of the above, compare FPS between DX11 and DX12 from the launcher. Most of the time DX12 will be better performance.

  1. Use the best hardware you can. Update all drivers.

The most important things to upgrade are your CPU as this is what bottlenecks the game most often.

blocks.html:
The next Important upgrade is an NVMe drive. This dramatically reduces stuttering. Put your OS and MO2 on the NVMe and offload everything else to a bulk SSD.

Finally, make sure your cooling is maximized so you aren't heat throttled.

Its also possible to mess with the Nvidia control panel, but do at your own risk.

Additional small tweaks that can be done:

-Set your monitors performance to fastest latency. This will smooth out the mouse and loading a little bit. Not all monitors have settings for this.

-Disable hardware acceleration on discord. This is important if your GPU is running too hard.

-Go to your windows search bar and type "Startup". Disable everything that isn't critical.

Use DLSS frame generation if you have a 40 series card. It adds a very small amount of input delay but also massively increases fps using predictive rendering 'n shit.

Use DLSS frame generation if you have a 40 series card. It adds a very small amount of input delay but also massively increases fps using predictive rendering 'n shit.

blocks.html:
Turn on Hardware-accelearted GPU scheduling for Windows.

Go to Settings -> System -> Display -> Graphics Settings -> toggle hardware accelearted gpu scheduling -> Restart PC

Possibly causes GPU related crashes with AMD cards. If you are crashing, disable this setting and see if that improves.

blocks.html: Example of launch options from section 2.
blocks.text: Example of launch options from section 2.

blocks.html:
If using multiple displays, unplug the 2nd one when not in use. If you still need it, lower the resolution so it isn't using as many system resources. If it's a 1080p monitor, run it in 720p or 480p, for example.

NEVER use 1080/720/480i (interlaced) as this creates tons of ghosting for no tangible benefit.

If it's a 1080p monitor, run it in 720p or 480p, for example. NEVER use 1080/720/480i (interlaced) as this creates tons of ghosting for no tangible benefit.

blocks.html: Ensure that the character preview in the character menu is PAUSED. Having it render can be a huge performance hit when this menu is open.
blocks.text: Ensure that the character preview in the character menu is PAUSED. Having it render can be a huge performance hit when this menu is open.

blocks.html:
This trick can gain you free FPS. Works for Windows users running an Nvidia GPU.

  1. Open the Nvidia app.
  2. Click on MO2 Settings
  3. Click Program Settings, MO2, and go to the DLSS Override setting.
  4. Set DLSS override to CUSTOM and the SUPER RESOLUTION setting to Preset F.
  5. Restart your game and see the results.

guides.title: Ergonomics & Gear
guides.summary: Practical recommendations for displays, controls, audio, seating, and peripherals that support long sessions and quick reactions.

blocks.html:
Ergonomics refers to creating an environment that let's one use their tools efficiently and easily. Make sure ergonomics are optimized prior to even logging into the game. Gear refers to the accessories that you use. Certain gear gives exceptionally value and can improve your gameplay. Others are a waste of money. This section will highlight where improvements can be made to facilitate success.

  • Monitors should be a minimum of 1080p with 60hz refresh rate. Response times of <1ms are ideal. If the game client gets more than 60fps you should look into upgrading to 144hz. An ultra-wide monitor gives a decent advantage over standard 16:X screens, but may take some adjustment.
  • Have a unobstructed mouse and mouse pad. If there are ANY hinderences that make mouse movement inconsistent they must be fixed. No tugging wires, plenty of room to move the mouse, and clean the surface. Make sure there are no bumps or debris underneath it. Make sure the mousepad it is an appropriate SIZE that matches your mouse sensitivity.
  • Keyboards are not a super important device to spend money on. An inexpensive keyboard can perform perfectly well; comfort and reliable inputs matter more than branding. Some offer unique features such as volume adjustment and extra hotkeys, but this is more of a luxury than a necessity.
  • Quality headphones are the single most important device to spend money on. Using audio cues in game to determine enemy location and threats is a significant advantage. Certain headphones allow for 7.1 surround or spatial awareness - tinker with these settings out to determine which works best.
  • Headphone equalizers can highlight certain frequencies while diminishing others. Raising treble and reducing bass can make sound a little "sharper" and more distinguishable. Quality headsets tend to have software which can have equalizer settings. Tinker with these settings to maximize hearing. A useful option is a FPS optimized equalizer which emphasizes the 125-2khz range.

blocks.html:
• A quality chair which has proper back support is critical not only to gameplay, but also for overall health. Back pain is a killer. Gamer racing chairs look cringe, but they tend to be pretty decent for keeping the back aligned. High quality "executive" style of chairs are built for rich fat guys, and they tend to enjoy their comfort.
  • Clean your desk. It is so easy to let clutter get out of control. Anything which obstructs gameplay needs to go.
  • A second monitor, particularly a vertical/portrait style monitor is really useful for using auxiliary applications. A 23-inch portrait monitor which is a godsend for viewing documents and Discord.
  • Be conscious of the body. After a several hour gaming session, if there is any pain, change it. Plenty of office worker focused comfort items such as keyboard wrist pads exist specifically to make computer operating more comfortable. Even anime titty mouse pads are a good choices for ergonomics.
  • DPI settings for a mouse are very personal. Higher DPI makes for quicker mouse pointer movement, while lower results in more precise. Mages tend to want lower mouse DPI while fighters tend to want higher. Typically people will use between 500-1000 DPI. Adjust as needed to what feels "right".
  • One test for mouse sensitivity adjustment in game is to stand 90 degrees to the right or left of a target. Snap your mouse to them. If you undershot them, increase your sensitivity. If you overshot them, reduce it.
  • Keep external distractions to a minimum. This particularly relates to animals, appliances, and the environment. Persistent background noise can mask important directional audio cues. Appliances such as washing machines, furnaces, or fans should be kept off or placed.

Go to Mouse Properties in the windows settings and disable "Enhance pointer precision". This is mouse acceleration and it is very bad.

needed to what feels "right". one test for mouse sensitivity adjustment in game is to stand 90 degrees to the right or left of a target. snap your mouse to them. if you undershot them, increase your sensitivity. if you overshot them, reduce it. keep external distractions to a minimum. this particularly relates to animals, appliances, and the environment. persistent background noise can mask important directional audio cues. appliances such as washing machines, furnaces, or fans should be kept off or placed. go to mouse properties in the windows settings and disable "enhance pointer precision". this is mouse acceleration and it is very bad.

guides.title: External Resources
guides.summary: A curated directory of useful Mortal Online 2 tools, official pages, community references, and specialist resources.

blocks.html:
While Mortal Nexus is intended to be a one-stop-shop for all Mortal Online 2 knowledge, there are a plethora of other resources that are worthy of checking out. They might have a different scope of their content, better understanding of a subject, or present it in a more consumable format.

The list focuses on resources with clear, practical value.These external resources are useful starting points:

Websites:

https://MortalData.com - The single most important tool for Mortal Online 2. It contains many different calculators including a character creator, workbench emulators, and even a wiki. Consider supporting their patreon page to show support for this incredible resource. The creator of this website can be found on the official discord under the discord handle “MortalData”.

https://arkhedian.org - Comprehensive lore website with lots of esoteric sources.

https://MortalOnlineMap.info - This interactive map was created by Pockets. It includes resource locations, dungeon information, and quite a few emulators including an alchemy calculator. It also has a chatroom + map pings that has been a centerpiece of MO2 banter for the past decade or so.

https://Mortalcodex.com - Has a character builder and extraction emulator plus more.

https://mortalforge.online - Many useful calculators and references.

https://mo2builder.com/ - Has many info + super useful siege calculator.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1170950/guides/ - This is the steam community guides page. many good information here by multiple authors.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170950 - Official Steam store page.

https://motrade.online/ - Trinket marketplace. Some nice integrated features and a clean UI.

https://mo2chronicles.com/ - A visual timeline of the political history of the game. Created by Pox

guides.title: FAQ & General Information
guides.summary: Straight answers to frequently asked questions about progression, survival, travel, combat, equipment, and everyday play.

blocks.html:
How do I identify a ring or amulet?

Enchanter NPCs are in all major cities. They identify trinkets for 10 silver each and can charge rings to full.

My skill is stuck at [level], what do I do?

First check that you have available skill points. Next, look at the skill in the menu and see if it says “Limitation:”. If there is a limitation, you need to raise the parent skill. If that does not work, cycle the skill level by pressing + and – a few times. If it is still stuck and none of the above worked, put in a support ticket.

How long does my loot bag stay in the world?

Generally, 30 minutes. Some things can change this, such as it being dry looted. It can remain in longer in some circumstances too, such as being

How long is the day/night cycle?

A 24-hour cycle in MO2 is ~2.4 hours long. Use /time to see current in-game time.

Can I craft laminated armors on Haven?

There are currently no ways to make laminated armors on Haven.

How do I join a guild?

Guilds can be found in the official discord recruitment section. You can also talk to people in game and network that way.

How do I party with someone?

Hold the interact key (default r) on someone then select invite to party. You can also type /invite [name], or right click them in the guild roster menu.

What can I leave Haven with?

Currently you can leave with everything you have equipped, plus 3g in value of items in your inventory. It is recommended to bring books, maalite, and geodes from the rat cave.

What is a clade/Clade gift?

Clades are subraces. A clade gift is essentially a talent point. Press c or Tab and go to Clade gift tab to see and assign your perks.

Does this game have a discord?

There are currently two primary discords used: The official, and the Unofficial.

The official can be found at: https://discord.gg/mortalonline

And the unofficial with looser rules can be found at: https://discord.gg/vKcxS5qnZP

blocks.html:
How do I cast a spell or use magic?

Buy a spellbook from a magic vendor for 1g and then press the U hotkey to access your magic. Bind these to your hotbar and then press the hotkey to charge the spell. By default, the Q hotkey targets your cursor target and E targets self. You can also repress the hotkey for the specific spell to throw it once charged. Note that some spells cast when the charge is completed and they cannot be held.

What is granum powder for?

For the vast majority of people, it is vendor trash. For specialized extractors it is used when refining tungsteel.

What taming level do I need for a horse? What creature control level do I need for a max level horse?

Level 1 taming is sufficient for all horses at all levels. You only need level 4 creature control with 100 Equidae lore. You need more creature control if your Equidae lore is not 100.

Do books read in real time and offline?

The book timer is real time, and books do read offline at full speed. Your reading time will vary a little depending on your reading level and intelligence attribute.

What material is best for weapons/armor?

There are too many variables to give an accurate answer to this. The standard is steel for most weapons. Reptile carapace is a great starting place for heavy armor. Keeled scales are strong for light armor.

How do I gain/lose weight?

Gain weight by eating many health food. Lose weight by losing HP and stamina and resting when you see a debuff. Losing weight is a lot more difficult than gaining weight. Weight loss potions exist.

How do I leave Haven?

Haven is likely to change in the future, but currently you must raise your clade level to 2 and then go south to a fishing village and interact with a statue near the pier.

What is thirst?

Thirst is your potion meter and has nothing to do with drinking water.

blocks.html:
This section will give guidance on etiquette and customs within the MO2 community.

  • Do not upload footage of friendly scrimmages. This decays trust and nullifies the point of scrims, which is to get better in a friendly environment.
  • Never ever betray passwords of the guild you are in. This is known as "insiding" and is a cardinal offense. If you are that dissatisfied with a group you are with, save your reputation and just leave.
  • Leaking DMs must only be done in extreme circumstances, such as exposing cheaters or insiders. Failure to abide by this means people confiding in you will never happen again.
  • When dueling, it is customary to not execute an opponent but rather to leave them in mercy mode. This is particularly true for in-town duels where ressurecting can be tedious for red players!
  • Use appropriate channels for asking questions about the game. It is generally frowned upon to spam people's inboxes about game questions (unless they have openly stated it is acceptable), or to clutter general chats with them. Use Newb-Help channels or reference resources.
  • Many guilds will have a PvP "callout" channel where they ping for potential fights. Keep these channels clear of clutter.
  • Do not spam voip to disrupt enemy comms mid-fight. This is super bad manners.
  • When doing PvE, decide on loot distribution before the loot drops. This will reduce the chance of a disagreement by a lot.
  • Do not give murdercounts in fair open world pvp, especially not when your group engages first.
  • Don't use help chat for PvP callouts.

blocks.html:
Most online communities develop their own vernacular. Mortal Online 2 is no different. Here is a list of terms one should familiarize themself with:

  • 0.5'd - Getting killed in less than half a second. Used to describe when someone dies really fast.
  • Alpha damage - Damage done at the very start of a fight with the intent to control the flow of a fight. Doing more burst damage at the start of a battle usually dictates the tempo, and who is able to be more aggressive. Usually this is done with magic or clade gifts/shouts and a charge.
  • Footie - Usually refers to a foot fighter. Can sometimes be used to describe any non-mounted build.
  • Gnat - Refers to the Greator Natorus, which is a unique and powerful extraction device. Pronounced Gee-Nat.
  • Kite/Kiting - The action of fleeing an enemy, usually with the intention of engaging when opportune.
  • MK - The city of Morin Khur. Does NOT stand for the village of Mohki.
  • Peel - Peeling is the act of attacking an enemy attacking one of your teammates.
  • Reset - Getting your groups HP/Stamina/Mana back to full. This is called to make sure no one dies, and is often called after killing 1 or 2 opponents.
  • Scroach - Someone who enters the battlefield with the sole purpose of stealing loot. Scroaches can also be a resurrected player who died in the fight.
  • S-Key - refers to using the S key to retreat away from an enemy while not turning your back on them.
  • Zoning - Staying in a location relative to an enemy group that does not allow them to engage you, but also allows you to keep track of them.
  • 3-2-1'ing - When attacking an enemy with 2 players, Players can time both attacks so they hit at the same moment and at least one of them becomes unparryable because of the timing. Countdown hitting is a way to beat people who are focused on parrying
  • Wheelchair - A character that is mounted ONLY and has no foot skills
  • Rope-a-dope - Causing your opponent to waste many stamina on pointless actions

Crush granum into amarantum. Crush amarantum into cuprum. While this is possible, it is wildly inefficient. Wait til mainland to focus on metals.

In game press escape and click Report Bug. Then use the dropdown menu to select bug report.

Nope.

• Can I get the red tindremic guard cape after leaving haven?

Yes! There is a spawner in the western steppes that drops it.

• What levels can I leave haven at?

You can leave haven starting at clade level 5. You can reach a maximum of clade 8 on the tutorial island.

Do a search function in the #item-catalog section.

guides.searchText: faq & general information general straight answers to frequently asked questions about progression, survival, travel, combat, equipment, and everyday play. how do i identify a ring or amulet? enchanter npcs are in all major cities. they identify trinkets for 10 silver each and can charge rings to full. my skill is stuck at [level], what do i do? first check that you have available skill points. next, look at the skill in the menu and see if it says “limitation:”. if there is a limitation, you need to raise the parent skill. if that does not work, cycle the skill level by pressing + and – a few times. if it is still stuck and none of the above worked, put in a support ticket. how long does my loot bag stay in the world? generally, 30 minutes. some things can change this, such as it being dry looted. it can remain in longer in some circumstances too, such as being how long is the day/night cycle? a 24-hour cycle in mo2 is ~2.4 hours long. use /time to see current in-game time. can i craft laminated armors on haven? there are currently no ways to make laminated armors on haven. how do i join a guild? guilds can be found in the official discord recruitment section. you can also talk to people in game and network that way. how do i party with someone? hold the interact key (default r) on someone then select invite to party. you can also type /invite [name], or right click them in the guild roster menu. what can i leave haven with? currently you can leave with everything you have equipped, plus 3g in value of items in your inventory. it is recommended to bring books, maalite, and geodes from the rat cave. what is a clade/clade gift? clades are subraces. a clade gift is essentially a talent point. press c or tab and go to clade gift tab to see and assign your perks. does this game have a discord? there are currently two primary discords used: the official, and the unofficial. the official can be found at: https://discord.gg/mortalonline and the unofficial with looser rules can be found at: https://discord.gg/vkcxs5qnzp how do i cast a spell or use magic? buy a spellbook from a magic vendor for 1g and then press the u hotkey to access your magic. bind these to your hotbar and then press the hotkey to charge the spell. by default, the q hotkey targets your cursor target and e targets self. you can also repress the hotkey for the specific spell to throw it once charged. note that some spells cast when the charge is completed and they cannot be held. what is granum powder for? for the vast majority of people, it is vendor trash. for specialized extractors it is used when refining tungsteel. what taming level do i need for a horse? what creature control level do i need for a max level horse? level 1 taming is sufficient for all horses at all levels. you only need level 4 creature control with 100 equidae lore. you need more creature control if your equidae lore is not 100. do books read in real time and offline? the book timer is real time, and books do read offline at full speed. your reading time will vary a little depending on your reading level and intelligence attribute. what material is best for weapons/armor? there are too many variables to give an accurate answer to this. the standard is steel for most weapons. reptile carapace is a great starting place for heavy armor. keeled scales are strong for light armor. how do i gain/lose weight? gain weight by eating many health food. lose weight by losing hp and stamina and resting when you see a debuff. losing weight is a lot more difficult than gaining weight. weight loss potions exist. how do i leave haven? haven is likely to change in the future, but currently you must raise your clade level to 2 and then go south to a fishing village and interact with a statue near the pier. what is thirst? thirst is your potion meter and has nothing to do with drinking water. this section will give guidance on etiquette and customs within the mo2 community. do not upload footage of friendly scrimmages. this decays trust and nullifies the point of scrims, which is to get better in a friendly environment. never ever betray passwords of the guild you are in. this is known as "insiding" and is a cardinal offense. if you are that dissatisfied with a group you are with, save your reputation and just leave. leaking dms must only be done in extreme circumstances, such as exposing cheaters or insiders. failure to abide by this means people confiding in you will never happen again. when dueling, it is customary to not execute an opponent but rather to leave them in mercy mode. this is particularly true for in-town duels where ressurecting can be tedious for red players! use appropriate channels for asking questions about the game. it is generally frowned upon to spam people's inboxes about game questions (unless they have openly stated it is acceptable), or to clutter general chats with them. use newb-help channels or reference resources. many guilds will have a pvp "callout" channel where they ping for potential fights. keep these channels clear of clutter. do not spam voip to disrupt enemy comms mid-fight. this is super bad manners. when doing pve, decide on loot distribution before the loot drops. this will reduce the chance of a disagreement by a lot. do not give murdercounts in fair open world pvp, especially not when your group engages first. don't use help chat for pvp callouts. most online communities develop their own vernacular. mortal online 2 is no different. here is a list of terms one should familiarize themself with: 0.5'd - getting killed in less than half a second. used to describe when someone dies really fast. alpha damage - damage done at the very start of a fight with the intent to control the flow of a fight. doing more burst damage at the start of a battle usually dictates the tempo, and who is able to be more aggressive. usually this is done with magic or clade gifts/shouts and a charge. footie - usually refers to a foot fighter. can sometimes be used to describe any non-mounted build. gnat - refers to the greator natorus, which is a unique guides.title: Mounted Archery
guides.summary: Build and operate a mounted archer with guidance on attributes, skills, bows, stamina use, positioning, and target selection.

blocks.html:
Mounted Archery

Build and operate a mounted archer with guidance on attributes, skills, bows, stamina use, positioning, and target selection.

Mounted Archers (MA’s) are a broad use build with many applications:

Strengths - Anti-Pet, Anti-Horse, PvE, mage harassment, chasing fleeing enemies

Weaknesses - Lancers (situational), mounted mages, foot longbowmen, steel+ armor, earthquake

There is a misconception that MA is low skill cap. This is extremely wrong. Unless an MA lands 100% headshots, dodges all incoming attacks, and makes the correct strategic calls, they are not reaching their peak potential and thus not hitting the skill cap. The reality is MA has a low skill floor meaning most people are capable of having some impacts without much input from the player. Even a bad player can hit the broadside of a campodon!

blocks.html:
Stats and Skills

Mounted Archery has several related skills, all which have different applications and priority.

Attributes:

Strength - Used to meet bow strength requirements. Pure MAs only need +9 over their bow strength for “unlimited” stam usage. Fighter/MAs should max their strength.

Dexterity - Alters the turn radius, acceleration/deceleration. Higher is better, but it is not mandatory

Constitution - Raises HP of the rider- not particularly useful unless the MA is also a fighter/hybrid. Can be sacrificed a reasonable amount to get points into psyche for hybrids.

Psyche - Magic resist, mana pool, and mana regen. Dump stat for fighters for the magic resist. Useful for hybrid MAs for the mana.

Intelligence - Increases magic effectiveness and mana pool/regen. Only use if hybrid.

blocks.html:
Skills:

Mandatory -

  • Archery - Increases damage
  • Controlled Riding - Required for Mounted • Archery
  • Mounted Archery - Removes the damage penalty

Recommended -

  • Aiming Technique - Reduces stamina usage while drawing bow
  • Controlled Aiming - Reduces wobble
  • Balance - Increases damage threshold to dismount by ~100%
  • Zoology Lores - Increases damage to target animals, and increases defense of living pets

Luxury -

  • Marksmanship - Increases weakspot chance by ~50%
  • Defensive Stance - Reduces incoming damage, and thus reduces chance of dismount

Build Specific -

  • Taming / Creature Control - Used to tame pets and increase level of living pets that can be held
  • Animal Care / Beast Mastery - Used to boost combat pet effectiveness and pet leveling speed
  • Necromancy / Necromantic Rituals - Allows use of undead ritual pets
  • Ecumenical / Mental Training / Mental Offense - Synergizes
  • Vitalism - Increases mana regen by 100%
  • Mounted Magery - Increases effectiveness of magic on mount by 100%

blocks.html:
Gear

Bow choice is generally straightforward. The majority of MAs will be using dense crepite shortbows as these have a fast fire rate, the “best” dps, and are cheap. Here is this bows stats:
blocks.text: Gear Bow choice is generally straightforward. The majority of MAs will be using dense crepite shortbows as these have a fast fire rate, the “best” dps, and are cheap. Here is this bows stats:

blocks.html:
Asymmetrical bows are generally not recommended as they have a slower fire rate and require more investment. Asymmetrical bows are better for longer range shooting, and versus armored targets. The “best-in-slot” asymmetrical bow as of patch 2.x.x.x is a spongewood / dense crepite bow with the sliders adjusted to the users strength. See #bowyery for more info.

There are 3 theaters of thought for MA armor:

  1. Max mana regen - light armor such as kallardian padded is ideal for keeping mana high. Only useful for hybrids.
  2. Splinted for max dismount resist (high blunt resist). Use plate scales and ironfur. Doubles as decent foot-viable gear.
  3. Fighter armor. Whatever you wear as a fighter.

Trinket selection for MAs are straightforward - you want pierce damage. Most everything else is secondary unless you are an MA hybrid which values casting spells- in which case add flat stats and +mana as secondary considerations after +pierce. An MA with +22% pierce damage is going to outscale all others. If blunt arrows make a return, swap to +22% blunt.

blocks.html:
Mount Choice

There are a great number of mounted options - some of them are fantastic, but most are suboptimal. This section will highlight a few notable pets and give guidelines for future mounts.

Rules of Thumb:

  • Smaller mounts are better. Hitbox size is a curse that you want to minimize. Smaller hitboxes = innate dodge chance.
  • Mounts that can wear armor are preferred over unarmored as this drastically increases their durability.
  • Use mounts that you have consistent access to. An animal that requires travelling across the entire map to get isn’t accessible.
  • Top speed is important, but not the end all. Aim for 1100+ speed.
  • Stamina is moderately important.

Current mountable pets with an intentionally vague measurement system. Pets change all the time. Use your best judgment when picking a mount.

blocks.html: Taming/Domination vs Ritualism - Mounted Archers have the option of doing either a living pet, or necromantic ritual summons. In general ritualism is the more powerful option, with more utility such as being able to stockpile corpses to raise. You are able to run a risen horse + a risen combat pet. However, this has many downsides such as cost, inability to enter towns, and guard aggro.

blocks.html:
Gameplay

Gameplay for mounted archers is deceptively simple. You ride out, you see a target, you shoot a target with arrows, right? There are actually many mechanics that go into mounted archery. This section will attempt to explain these mechanics to fine tune your MA gameplay.

There are two aiming styles for MA. The first style is simple mouse aiming, which is intended for more accurate shooting. The second involves leading with the crosshair, “pausing”, and waiting for the enemy to run into the kill zone and then releasing at an appropriate time. The pausing style is very good versus large targets, AI, pets, and other enemies with consistent movement. The second style is appropriate in a mount vs. mount scenario.

Player versus Environment (PvE) -

The general PvE strategy is to pull enemies with your bow and kite around them in a counterclockwise motion. Since the bow is restricted to shooting from approximately 240 to 60 degrees (rounded and pictured below), going counterclockwise keeps the target in your kill zone.

blocks.html: Certain PvE opponents have ranged attacks, which can complicate MAing. The rule of thumb for this is to determine if you can safely kill it without risk of death or dismount. If not, back off and use your mount as a combat pet if applicable. Most ranged AI such as outlaws and sators can be safely solo’d, but in groups they pose a bigger threat. Bite off what you can chew, and always play safe in case there is a gank.

blocks.html:
Player versus Player (PvP) -

The end goal of a PvP encounter is to kill your opponent. This is not always feasible as an MA. Remember that MA’s are a skirmish-type playstyle, and there is no shame in fleeing an unwinnable engagement. For example, a steel clad thursar with a longbow is about as hard of a counter as there is, and back up from them is probably the wise play.

MAs have one significant tool at their disposal that functions well in PvP - the combat mount. Using a pet such as a taur dog, the MA has the option to dismount and either switch to a melee weapon, magic, or simply use archery while the mount engages a foot opponent. One good strategy that hybrid MAs have at their disposal is to dismount an enemy, dismount themselves, and sic the attack pet on while also using corrupt and death hand. The combination of pet damage and magic damage makes rather quick work of most enemies. This mostly applies to 1v1 scenarios as pets tend to become fodder once focused by multiple opponents.

In a group setting there are a few priorities of an MA:

  1. Kill pets. Pets are natural prey of an MA and this will reduce the number of targets.
  2. Counter enemy mounteds, particularly lancers. Dismount enemy mounted players so that they are forced into suboptimal play.
  3. Harass the enemy mage line
  4. Support damage versus fighters
  5. Prevent enemies from fleeing

blocks.html: In the context of MA vs MA, the winner is usually the one with the better mount, better aim, better movement (hoofwork?), and better mount armor. Getting into the blind spot of an enemy MA (their right side) is a good strategy for winning the engagement as they can’t fight back.

blocks.html:
There are a few important auxiliary concepts to keep in mind when doing mounted archery:

  • AA vs AS - Anti-Air vs. Anti-Surface. Think of mounts as a type of aircraft. Fighting other mounted players is sort of like having a 2 dimensional fighter dogfight. Fighting against players on foot is like doing bombing runs. Your gameplay style should adjust accordingly. Additionally, different “loadouts”, such as using a taur dog for AA and a slower and tankier mount such as a Molva would be acceptable versus a foot group. Other mounts, such as a cougar, could be seen as a quick “interceptor”. Framing mounted PvP in this manner may help give understanding of the roles that different players fulfill with their specific build and gameplay choices.
  • Projection of Intent - Visible behaviors that other players make that give you information. They are foreshadowing their play, and allows you to formulate a counter. For example, a dex mage running at full speed towards you is an abnormal behavior, and 9/10 it indicates they are going to earthquake you. Seeing this sort of behavior is projecting that they intend to earthquake you. With this in mind, the appropriate response is to break contact, or potentially to dismount and sic your mount on them.

blocks.html:
What Impacts Archery Damage

What all goes into increasing damage with a bow? A surprising number of things.

  • Ranged Combat / Archery skill - No brainer.
  • +Pierce Rings - Gives a strong flat bonus to damage, currently up to 22%
  • Zoology Lores - At 100 zoology, there is a +20% damage to your targets, excluding primata/player lores.
  • Draw length - Full draws will give full damage, while quick/partial draws will incur a damage penalty
  • Marksmanship/weakspot - This is an indirect boost to damage. Headshots with a bow that proc a weakspot have around 60-70% armor penetration.
  • The upcoming "alvarin armor penetration" gift - This is probably going to be tied into the Runner's High clade gift, and will give a flat armor penetration value that does not stack with weakspots.
  • Shooting into water - There is a penalty for shooting into or from underwater.
  • Mastery +pierce - This boosts damage 3% when maxed. If blunt arrows release, +blunt will be used.
  • Mastery +weakspot - Indirectly boosts damage through weakspot headshots.
  • Mastery +damage to AI - including damage to rituals, untamed, tamed, and dominated pets.
  • Arrow type - Longbow Arrow (in longbows ONLY) > Broadhead > Bodkin in terms of raw damage, although longbow arrows cannot weakspot.
  • Mounted Archery (when mounted) - There is a 50% penalty to bow damage while mounted that is negated by having 100 mounted archery. Ergo at 50 mounted archery skill, you deal 75% damage as you would on foot.

Things that do NOT increase bow damage:

  • Strength - The strength of a bow correlates with the bow range stat, but Players can also make absurdly high strength requirement bows with low range. Having a higher strength requirement on a bow in of itself does not increase damage.
  • Dexterity - Dex has no impact on bow damage. At best it gives extra stamina which distantly and indirectly helps archery. There is a slight weakspot increase with dex.

Note some of these are subject to change with balance patches.

anti-pet, anti-horse, pve, mage harassment, chasing fleeing enemies weaknesses - lancers (situational), mounted mages, foot longbowmen, steel+ armor, earthquake there is a misconception that ma is low skill cap. this is extremely wrong. unless an ma lands 100% headshots, dodges all incoming attacks, and makes the correct strategic calls, they are not reaching their peak potential and thus not hitting the skill cap. the reality is ma has a low skill floor meaning most people are capable of having some impacts without much input from the player. even a bad player can hit the broadside of a campodon! stats and skills mounted archery has several related skills, all which have different applications and priority. attributes: strength - used to meet bow strength requirements. pure mas only need +9 over their bow strength for “unlimited” stam usage. fighter/mas should max their strength. dexterity - alters the turn radius, acceleration/deceleration. higher is better, but it is not mandatory constitution - raises hp of the rider- not particularly useful unless the ma is also a fighter/hybrid. can be sacrificed a reasonable amount to get points into psyche for hybrids. psyche - magic resist, mana pool, and mana regen. dump stat for fighters for the magic resist. useful for hybrid mas for the mana. intelligence - increases magic effectiveness and mana pool/regen. only use if hybrid. skills: mandatory - archery - increases damage controlled riding - required for mounted • archery mounted archery - removes the damage penalty recommended - aiming technique - reduces stamina usage while drawing bow controlled aiming - reduces wobble balance - increases damage threshold to dismount by ~100% zoology lores - increases damage to target animals, and increases defense of living pets luxury - marksmanship - increases weakspot chance by ~50% defensive stance - reduces incoming damage, and thus reduces chance of dismount build specific - taming / creature control - used to tame pets and increase level of living pets that can be held animal care / beast mastery - used to boost combat pet effectiveness and pet leveling speed necromancy / necromantic rituals - allows use of undead ritual pets ecumenical / mental training / mental offense - synergizes vitalism - increases mana regen by 100% mounted magery - increases effectiveness of magic on mount by 100% builds there are two main types of mas: ma hybrids (commonly called arcane archers) fighters with ma ma hybrids can be foot viable or “wheelchair” (bound to their mount). a wheelchair build will generally be human, and focus on magic skills in addition to archery. here is an example build: a foot viable ma hybrid will include foot skills- both movement skills and a weapon skill. it should also be running heavier armor. here is a tested example build with trinkets enabled: note that this build does not contain sprinting as that is many points for not huge benefit anymore. for a fighter build, just imagine any footfighter build with 100 archery and 100 mounted archery. add 100 aiming technique and controlled aiming if you can fit it. mastery system choices for an ma will depend on their purpose. if a hybrid ma, value bow strength requirements, weakspot chance, sway reduction, +3% pierce damage, and magic skills. if a fighter with ma as an addon, simply value the fighter skills primarily. gear bow choice is generally straightforward. the majority of mas will be using dense crepite shortbows as these have a fast fire rate, the “best” dps, and are cheap. here is this bows stats: asymmetrical bows are generally not recommended as they have a slower fire rate and require more investment. asymmetrical bows are better for longer range shooting, and versus armored targets. the “best-in-slot” asymmetrical bow as of patch 2.x.x.x is a spongewood / dense crepite bow with the sliders adjusted to the users strength. see #bowyery for more info. there are 3 theaters of thought for ma armor: max mana regen - light armor such as kallardian padded is ideal for keeping mana high. only useful for hybrids. splinted for max dismount resist (high blunt resist). use plate scales and ironfur. doubles as decent foot-viable gear. fighter armor. whatever you wear as a fighter. trinket selection for mas are straightforward - you want pierce damage. most everything else is secondary unless you are an ma hybrid which values casting spells- in which case add flat stats and +mana as secondary considerations after +pierce. an ma with +22% pierce damage is going to outscale all others. if blunt arrows make a return, swap to +22% blunt. mount choice there are a great number of mounted options - some of them are fantastic, but most are suboptimal. this section will highlight a few notable pets and give guidelines for future mounts. rules of thumb: smaller mounts are better. hitbox size is a curse that you want to minimize. smaller hitboxes = innate dodge chance. mounts that can wear armor are preferred over unarmored as this drastically increases their durability. use mounts that you have consistent access to. an animal that requires travelling across the entire map to get isn’t accessible. top speed is important, but not the end all. aim for 1100+ speed. stamina is moderately important. current mountable pets with an intentionally vague measurement system. pets change all the time. use your best judgment when picking a mount. taming/domination vs ritualism - mounted archers have the option of doing either a living pet, or necromantic ritual summons. in general ritualism is the more powerful option, with more utility such as being able to stockpile corpses to raise. you are able to run a risen horse + a risen combat pet. however, this has many downsides such as cost, inability to enter towns, and guard aggro. gameplay gameplay for mounted archers is deceptively simple. you ride out, you see a target, you shoot a target with arrows, right? there are actually many mechanics that go into mounted archery. this section will attempt to explain these mechanics to fine tune your ma gameplay. there are two aiming styles for ma. the first style is simple mouse aiming, which is intended for more accurate shooting. the second involves leading with the crosshair, “pausing”, and waiting for the enemy to run into the kill zone and then releasing at an appropriate time. the pausing style is very good versus large targets, ai, pets, and other enemies with consistent movement. the second style is appropriate in a mount vs. mount scenario. player versus environment (pve) - the general pve strategy is to pull enemies with your bow and kite around them in a counterclockwise motion. since the bow is restricted to shooting from approximately 240 to 60 degrees (rounded and pictured below), going counterclockwise keeps the target in your kill zone.  certain pve opponents have ranged attacks, which can complicate maing. the rule of thumb for this is to determine if you can safely kill it without risk of death or dismount. if not, back off and use your mount as a combat pet if applicable. most ranged ai such as outlaws and sators can be safely solo’d, but in groups they pose a bigger threat. bite off what you can chew, and always play safe in case there is a gank. player versus player (pvp) - the end goal of a pvp encounter is to kill your opponent. this is not always feasible as an ma. remember that ma’s are a skirmish-type playstyle, and there is no shame in fleeing an unwinnable engagement. for example, a steel clad thursar with a longbow is about as hard of a counter as there is, and back up from them is probably the wise play. mas have one significant tool at their disposal that functions well in pvp - the combat mount. using a pet such as a taur dog, the ma has the option to dismount and either switch to a melee weapon, magic, or simply use archery while the mount engages a foot opponent. one good strategy that hybrid mas have at their disposal is to dismount an enemy, dismount themselves, and sic the attack pet on while also using corrupt and death hand. the combination of pet damage and magic damage makes rather quick work of most enemies. this mostly applies to 1v1 scenarios as pets tend to become fodder once focused by multiple opponents. in a group setting there are a few priorities of an ma: kill pets. pets are natural prey of an ma and this will reduce the number of targets. counter enemy mounteds, particularly lancers. dismount enemy mounted players so that they are forced into suboptimal play. harass the enemy mage line support damage versus fighters prevent enemies from fleeing in the context of ma vs ma, the winner is usually the one with the better mount, better aim, better movement (hoofwork?), and better mount armor. getting into the blind spot of an enemy ma (their right side) is a good strategy for winning the engagement as they can’t fight back. there are a few important auxiliary concepts to keep in mind when doing mounted archery: aa vs as - anti-air vs. anti-surface. think of mounts as a type of aircraft. fighting other mounted players is sort of like having a 2 dimensional fighter dogfight. fighting against players on foot is like doing bombing runs. your gameplay style should adjust accordingly. additionally, different “loadouts”, such as using a taur dog for aa and a slower and tankier mount such as a molva would be acceptable versus a foot group. other mounts, such as a cougar, could be seen as a quick “interceptor”. framing mounted pvp in this manner may help give understanding of the roles that different players fulfill with their specific build and gameplay choices. projection of intent - visible behaviors that other players make that give you information. they are foreshadowing their play, and allows you to formulate a counter. for example, a dex mage running at full speed towards you is an abnormal behavior, and 9/10 it indicates they are going to earthquake you. seeing this sort of behavior is projecting that they intend to earthquake you. with this in mind, the appropriate response is to break contact, or potentially to dismount and sic your mount on them. volume of fire - this refers to the amount of arrows going downrange. there is a spectrum of how fast one shoots - you can shoot a extremely number of arrows with low accuracy, or you can take 30 seconds to aim each shot. the goal of an ma is to land a consistent stream of fast shots, while not taking too long for each shot. getting an appropriate number of arrows on target is needed to do a sufficient amount of dps. find the balance of fire rate and accurate shots that produces results. zoning - guides.summary: Less obvious interactions and edge cases that the game rarely explains, collected for fast reference and practical testing.

blocks.html:
• Type /emote squat when riding a mount to enter a special phase where the rider hugs the mount and is less targetable
  • Certain spells are impacted by the psyche of the target- even if they are friendly. For example, mental healing works best when targetting a low psyche ally. Sacrificial eruption is more effective when hitting a low psyche target as well.
  • Contrary to popular belief, longbows CAN weakspot- they just need to use broadhead arrows instead of longbow arrows
  • Type /loot when standing over a bag that is underground. This will take a second to activate, but it looks everything close to you.
  • To get a good idea of your ping to the server, go to windows cmd and type- ping 51.89.234.64 - then hit enter.
  • The strength calculation to use mounted weapons is the weapon weight x30. A 1kg weapon thus requires 30 strength to use, a 2kg requires 60, 3kg 90, etc.
  • Dexterity tooltip says it gives weakspot. This does NOT apply to bows.

blocks.html:
• Height works off of decimals - you can eat size food and it will incrementally gain. Age does not follow this same pattern, and any potions drunk must be >1 age to work.
  • Stamina and mana regeneration are % based. The greater the resource pool, the proportionally faster it regenerates.
  • "Reward" capes from the escape menu can be deleted and reclaimed ad infinitum.
  • Killing a horse allows for murdercounts if the player dies soon after. This only works if the player is killed by another player, AI, or other natural causes. Using the suicide button does not allow for murdercounting.
  • Wood structures have a natural 50% damage resistance. Stone structures have a natural 80% damage resistance.
  • Doors can be broken into by smashing them with weapons. However, their defense is proportional to the HP of the structure. A building with 100% HP has 100% door defence. A building with 50% HP has 50% door defense.
  • Aggressive stance does NOT work with mounted combat.

blocks.html:
• Shields cause equipment hits when struck. The equation for how damage is calculated is [shield defensive stats] + [chest armor defensive stats] + [defensive stance bonuses] + [trinket bonuses] + [clade gift bonuses] + [mastery bonuses] + [magic effects such as akh bond]. The most misunderstood aspect of this is that the chest piece is always what stacks, no matter what part of the shield is struck.
  • Pet equipment, no matter the size of the animal, is uniform in weight, defense, and material cost. Steel heavy campodon armor is the same as steel heavy bear armor in all regards except what it can be equipped on.
  • Arrows only consume bow durability when they hit a valid target. Missing a shot does not use bow durability.
  • Risen pets always use the "medium" sized model of the creature, and never the young nor elder/alpha versions. This means they are smaller at max level than their living counterparts.
  • Pets can be flagged as in combat while mounted, gaining the 4x xp bonus.
  • Arrow velocity is reduced when it hits water - meaning there is reduced damage the longer it is in water. You can even see it shoot slowly!
  • Many spells are not impacted by the -50% mount penalty for not having mounted magery. For example, mindblast always hits for maximum, atrophy always reduces stamina by the full amount, earthquake will always dismount, and corrupt always fulfils its role of preventing healing.

blocks.html:
• Weapons have distance "sweet spots". In most situations, weapons do most damage when at maximum range from the target but still making contact.
  • /loot was added as a command a long time ago but documentation for it is non-existent. Use this while standing over/near loot that is stuck in collision or underground.
  • Horses have a default follow distance when pressing the follow command. Double tapping the follow command causes the horse to approach you even closer, to within bag opening distance.
  • Resting in a house gives huge regeneration boosts. In a house + with a campfire is even higher.
  • House doors can be broken down. Their defense is proportional to the HP of the structure, i.e. at 100% hp, the defense is 100%, and at 50% hp, the defense is 50%. That enables attackers to break into houses while sieging to kill repairers.
  • Spur on is a beastmastery ability which increases the stamina regen of a mount, and forces them into 4th speed. This is one of the few mechanics which allows mounted mages to adjust their speed mid cast.
  • All resources in game have an associated RGBa color value. This is observable via the color of potions made with an item.

blocks.html:
• Emotes can be maintained while running. Do the emote, don't move, and then hit your autorun key. This has some RP elements, but also messes with your hitbox a little
  • Weapon swapping is faster than manually unsheathing the weapon. That enables for quicker casting swaps.
  • Using a potion with a weapon out is slow- swap weapons or sheathe first to speed up the process!
  • Capes are mostly aesthetics only. However, certain capes have a large profile and can actual be used to hide animations and trick enemies. Proper camera movement is required for this.
  • Miasma is a spell that counts as poison damage, and is thus impacted by affects that reduce poison (such as the thursar clade gift)
  • Elementalism spells are either pure magic damage, or they have a physical component to them. Many water spells are modified by slash damage, some earth spells impacted by blunt, and ice are modified by pierce. The spell tooltip will contain the info needed to know this.
  • Some tasks have a "quick completion" bonus that doubles the amount of XP given. Soldier tasks lose this bonus upon death, while hunter, foraging, and fishing, do not. Bounties are completely lost on death.

• The Alvarin Warcry also increases jump height, and likely increases weakspot chance
  • "Bleed" effects are removed by using a bandage
  • Your strength is taken into account for blocking/parry damage reduction. The lower your strength, the more chip damage occurs
  • Shields have an inherent defense bonus versus AI which has unparryable attacks (i.e. mino king, sators)
  • Miasma gives mental offense XP per tick. Using it to splash on big groups of mobs is fast to level it
  • There is a small microphone icon next to players names when they are in game and have VOIP enabled. If there is no microphone, it either means their VOIP is disabled or they are alt tabbed
  • The control undead spell lasts for 15 minutes on player-made walkers. Re-casting control undead on them refreshes this timer without the need to summon a new walker.

• Earthquake dismounts when it is self-cast and hits the target, or when it directly hits the target. If it hits the targets mount, it does NOT dismount. This is likely a bug
  • When parrying with a shield, the defense stats of the shield are added to the defense calculation, resulting in heavily reduced damage
  • Every skill with an attribute bonus has a chance of raising that attribute everytime that skill is used. For example, the Crusher appliance has +intelligence and +strength, meaning you can gain both when crushing! The lower level an attribute, the easier it is to raise it
  • The Thursar Battlecry and Oghmir Rock Solid are clade gifts which act as taunts for nearby untamed AI.
  • Tactician only works for your pet if you are guilded. Unguilded pets do not receive the bonus.
  • Every 2 points in the height stat is equal to 1 size, and thus costs 1 attribute point.
  • Max engineering and advanced engineering makes a character build 5x faster.

blocks.html:
• Structures that are under construction lose a high portion of their defensive bonus. For example, a medium house goes from 80% defense to 62%. The normal defensive values are restored once the structure is completed.
  • Shield bashing a target that is jumping gives them a large boost.
  • Shield bashing distance is determined by the strength of the basher
  • Housing give a significant boost to regeneration when resting inside of them. You can tell if this bonus is active if the logout timer in that spot is 10 seconds. 10 seconds = yes, 120 seconds = no.
  • Accepting the gold from a COD >10k gold will actually stack all of the gold into 1 pile. Players can have a stack of gold up to at least 99,999
  • Depositing a stack of gold >10k will force the stack to split into 10k + the remaining. For example, if you deposit a stack of 45k, it becomes 10k + 35k.
  • It is possible for AI to fight each other. For example, if you are fighting a creature with an AoE attack such as alchemist bowman and the bowman hits a bear with its explosive shot, the bear will attack the bowman if enough aggro is generated.

You can tell if this bonus is active if the logout timer in that spot is 10 seconds. 10 seconds = yes, 120 seconds = no. Accepting the gold from a COD >10k gold will actually stack all of the gold into 1 pile. Players can have a stack of gold up to at least 99,999 Depositing a stack of gold >10k will force the stack to split into 10k + the remaining. For example, if you deposit a stack of 45k, it becomes 10k + 35k. It is possible for AI to fight each other. For example, if you are fighting a creature with an AoE attack such as alchemist bowman and the bowman hits a bear with its explosive shot, the bear will attack the bowman if enough aggro is generated.

• You can choose which side to dismount on by targeting the left or right side of your pet.
  • Living pets change their size at level 26 to become an adult. They change their size again at 100 to become "alpha/elder". Pets must be a minimum of level 26 to mount, with a few exceptions like terrorbirds. Risen are always the adult (but not elder/alpha) model.
  • Mental Projectile is one of the few offensive spells that always penetrates magic reflection (without expending it).
  • Certain spells will always kill and skip mercy mode - Mental Projectile, Mindblast, and Shock are a few.
  • Melee can kill and skip mercy mode if the damage is high enough. Usually this is only really seen when a 2h maul hits a mage.
  • Zoology lores give 20% damage mitigation and 20% damage bonus to living pets under your control. Risen does not gain a benefit from zoology.
  • Getting hit by physical damage while banadaging lowers the amount healed at the end of the timer. Minor bandages take the largest HP loss penalty, while regular and major bandages are supposed to have a reduced penalty.

blocks.html:
• Fall damage scales with inventory/equipment weight. The more weight, the more damage.
  • Guild ranks are gained by capturing supply towers and spending prominence. They can also be lost by losing a keep, surrendering a wardec, or running out of upkeep in the chancerry.
  • Arrows that hit a body of water lose velocity and damage the further they travel in water.
  • In beta there was a good chance at lightning strikes during rainy weather. This could hit players. It has been disabled, but may return in the future.
  • It takes approximately 3 hours for a pet to go from 0 to 1000 hunger.
  • Looting a war combatant target (orange) also flags the looter as war combatant and can be killed by guard. This doesn't apply to bystanders who see the bag as blue, although they may flag for looting blue bags.
  • The broker has several backend keywords that aren't readily apparent, particularly with trinkets (which have hidden names). An Amulet of Tukh indicates it is a mounted archery amulet - try searching Tukh on the broker!

• If there are for some reason multiple banks in your vacinity, /bank will only open the nearest one.
  • When guards do significant damage (possibly any) to an NPC such as an outlaw, the loot drop and clade XP from that NPC is disabled.
  • Houses are bound to your steam/epic account. Ownership remains valid even after a character is deleted.
  • Concentration (chance to resist spell casting interruption) is only 50% as effective on mount as it is on foot. This caps out at 50% with full concentration skill and all masteries.
  • All mounts regen stamina and the same rate.
  • Mount swim speed is 1/4th of the land speed.
  • Weapon skills not only increase average damage, they also increase the amount of stamina a successful parry restores.
  • Gem effect luck has a greater impact than people realize- with 0% luck an amethyst can only hit 6% [pierce/blunt/slash] -> with max effect luck this raises the cap to 7%.

• Magic XP gained per cast is based on the base cost of the spell, before reductions such as mental focus.
  • Typing /? gives a chat response of most chat commands.
  • Certain elements of the UI can be pre-patch. For example, there is an old set of pet command icons that are only obtainable by downloading a prepatch UI file!

  • Zoology lores as a general rule give a damage bonus versus the target. An exception to this are the "simian" lores, which are the lores for the player characters.

  • Spells have a hidden "alignment" to them. Good spells don't turn you grey, while "evil" spells turn you grey on cast. This is a legacy assignment from MO1 that was just hidden for MO2 but still has gameplay impacts.

blocks.html:
• Pet equipment weight and defenses are uniform across all creature types. Steel campodon armor weighs the same as steel horse armor.
  • Pets must be within 30m of the player to gain combat xp.
  • Wood from the lightest/least dense to the heaviest/most dense: Spongewood -> Whitewood -> Firmwood -> Greywood -> Dapplewood -> Brownwood -> Blackwood -> Ironwood -> Stonewood*. Density impacts stats like weight, durability, etc.
  • The subsisting skill at level 100 cuts the mercy mode timer by 50% and increases the HP regained drastically.
  • You can estimate your location on the in-game map (hotkey M) by looking for nearby named TC structures and control towers.
  • Lance damage follows the laws of general relativity. Running into a lance does massively increased damage, while running away from it reduces it by a lot.
  • Loot is localized. A monster in one location might have drops that one is another location does not. The prime example of this are camp sators compared to temple sators - the temple sators are far more lucrative!

• Reputation of 0 is enough to enter a city. -1 is where you become detested.
  • Guilds can only be wardec'd if they have at least 2 murderers in them.
  • If a non-war target horse rider has a wardec target PASSENGER, the horse itself can still be targetted by guard towers.
  • War flag takes precedent over red flag. A war target that is red will flag attackers in town as war combatants.
  • this remains unconfirmed, but local grey flag supercedes war combatant status (but does not display). I.e. if someone heals a red friend in town, orange flagged players can then attack the healer. Test at your own risk.
  • Players killed by a boulder will have all of their weapons and armor completely obliterated.
  • Risen pets can be left anywhere in the world and they will passively gain experience as long as you remain logged on

blocks.html:
• Daily tasks can be opened on any day and saved/turned in any other day- but the day you turn in it, it counts as "completed" for that specific day!
  • Soldier and hunter tasks lose their "quick execution" bonus when you die. The forager task does not lose this bonus. Bounty tasks always disappear when you die, even if they are completed.
  • Weight gain is usually impacted by health reserves, but Players can gain weight by eating over your stamina reserve cap.
  • Amulet defense stats are calculated AFTER all other values, meaning they are more effective on light armor than on heavy.
  • Durability damage done to weapons is based on what type of material it is hitting. Hitting a naked takes basically no dura while hitting plate armor incurs many dura loss.
  • The person who gets the very last hit on an AI sees its bag almost immediately. Anyone else sees it approximately a second later. This gives looting priority to the last-hitter.
  • Likewise to the last one, loot luck and rare trinket gem luck on proc for the person doing the last hit. If you are grouped and one person is running luck rings, let them get the last hits- especially on bosses!

• Armor and inventory weight update at a delayed rate. This means its possible to pick up absurd amounts of weight and move for a few moments before encumbrance hits.
  • The corrupt spell only cancels out bandages when the bandage finishes. A bandage timer of 10 seconds while corrupted for 9 seconds left will still heal.
  • Equerries that are destroyed will still have pets in them when a new one is placed in that same location.
  • Multiple equerries that are in close proximity can be on the same "micro node", and share pet stockpiles.
  • The HP/s mastery gift in the top right mastery tree do not gain the extra stygantrope bonus
  • Blunt damage masteries and rings work with elementalism boulder, starfall, stone, and other blunt based spells.
  • Houses that are freshly built are able to be sieged without a declaration. Houses that are over 24 hours old with a guild stone must have a siege declaration to be sieged.

• Steam maintenance is usually done around 6pm EST/11pm GMT which results in login disruptions.
  • Shields stored on the backup "weapon set" do not impact armor weight. When the weapon set is swapped, the weight penalty kicks in.
  • 1 Size = 2 Height. "Height food" is actually size food. Character models physically increase when size increases, not when height itself increases.
  • Killing player pets count for task progress. (risen pets don't count).
  • Pets gain XP when the pet owner is within 30m of them and an AI dies. The AI that dies can be outside of this 30m radius. The AI could theoretically be infinite distance away from the pet and it would still gain xp.
  • Pets automatically teleport to players when they do not have valid pathing to the player. There are two conditions where this is disabled: if the pet is in a house, and if the pet recently took damage.
  • Daily tasks can be accepted and saved for another day, but the player cannot accept a new daily task on the cycle that the initial daily task was turned in.

blocks.html:
• Holding alt and right clicking multiple items in your inventory queues them all for deletion. This is a great way to mass delete.
  • Weapons can left, center, and right block while mounted. You cannot overhead block however.
  • Inventory bags can be renamed by control right clicking them when they are in your inventory
  • You can bandage while resting and not interrupt the resting bonus.
  • Thrusting (couching) while mounted does heavy durability damage to the weapon. Slashing does NOT do heavy dura damage.
  • Reds that are attacked by blues first can freely loot the blue as if the bag was "local grey" flagged.
  • AI which retreats (i.e. alchemist bowman) can be forced to a cliff edge, where it will be forced to stand and fight.

blocks.html:
• The type of pet you are mounted on determines the sway pattern of the weapon you are using. I.e. terrorbird forces a left/right bob while a taur dog is up and down.
  • Pets which are abandoned usually disappear after 20-30 minutes.
  • "Low quality" ore nodes are ones in locations that are too accessible, such as in a city. These obviously give really poor yields.
  • Double yield ore nodes are in high value areas such as granum pass. The gathering rate on these is 2x, but they still give the normal total of ore per spot (~3333 til it starts to deplete).
  • Using a clade respec potion from the magic vendor penalizes you 10% of your total clade xp. Usually you can respec without losing clade levels, especially if you have a good bit of mastery XP.
  • Each pet level linearly increases health, damage, defense, and rider weight.
  • All AI, including bosses, will be between level 0 and 125 and have varying stats because of it. This is why bosses like the Nitre queen can be really easy or really difficult! There are outlier cases where AI are above 125, and that is either due to a bug or SV making that happen.

blocks.html:
• Manually de-leveling a skill causes it to be at the maximum XP of the previous level
  • Going overencumbered while in an otherwise dismounted state (i.e. falling), overrides the rule and forces a dismount
  • If you are ever stuck in a falling state while on a mount and cannot dismount, combine the last two mechanics described. - your armor weight by 1 point, and go overencumbered to force a dismount, then gain 1 xp in armor training to regain it. Only works if your set is tailored to your armor training level.
  • Ore meteors drop relic fragments. Radiant fragments drop proportionally to how much owe is mined (i.e. max mining/lore increases chance per hit). The ore itself refresh slowly over time until they collapse.
  • Wave relics are a great choice to chase because they are basically guaranteed orb drops when you kill the boss of the final wave.
  • Many client-sided light effects such as casting spells or preparing a placeable interact with the world and can give information. Use these as ghetto light sources when in dark places.
  • Horse taming is interrupted if another target crosses the targetting crosshair mid-tame. Mitigate this by either looking straight up or straight down while taming.

blocks.html:
• When rerolling from a human to another race, be sure to subtract 50 skill points from a skill you wish to lose due to losing the bonus of the "Versatile" clade gift. Failure to do so will cause it to automatically yoink points from something you probably don't want it to.
  • Purple and blue relic meteors last approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes before decaying.
  • Water ward does not allow melee, ranged, or direct target magic to penetrate through it. Hug a wall and water ward to have a survival tool against most threats.
  • The elementalism spells "Shadow" and "Mirage" prevent targetting through them. Players can "lock" people out of interacting with doors by dropping these spells on them.
  • Your armor weight, but not your inventory weight, impacts your jump height. Take off armor to gain a temporary boost to jumping.
  • Weapons and shields in your "alternative" weapon set that is not selected do not incur weight penalties of any kind. Use this as a pocket storage to carry extra loot back from a fight!
  • Potions with an effect that requires a length follow a √(Square Root) formula to see if their effect occurs. So 1 unit of 100% magic reflect works, but 2 units of 50% magic reflect doesn't. It requires a disproportionate amount of magic reflect potion units to work when the value is under 100%. Purification potions, which do not have a "length" value, work more simply- 10 units of 10% purification potion = 100% potency and it works. See #alchemy for a better explanation.

  • Stolen books can be read
  • Stolen items which are combinable (key fragments, artifact pieces, polish, etc), can be combined to strip them of the stolen status. Similarly, cookable items can be cooked to become unstolen
  • Move distance on mobile siege weapons is influenced by your characters strength
  • Relic siphons, when activated, steal a reliquary relic in ~50 minutes
  • Relic siphons that are deactivated are NOT fully reset. Their timer counts up instead of down. What this means is a relic siphon placed for 30 minutes then deactivated and immediately reactivated will still have ~20 minutes. If the siphon is placed for 30 minutes and then deactivated and reactivated after 20 minutes will be ~40 minutes until the relic drops

• Ritualism can raise many pets, but not all carcass works. Using an incompatible carcass (sator vessel, player carcass, fish, etc) will tell you that there is something wrong with the carcass

All gems (and many other things such as coins) work in the ritual table, BUT not all of them actually have effects. The bounty hunter coin notably does not increase pet damage by a measurable amount

  • The Alvarin "Stalker" clade gift which reduces aggro range does NOT affect guards. They will continue to aggro at a player with this at maximum distance
  • Winning a small amount in the lottery gives a little jingle. Winning a BIG amount (300+) gives fancy fanfare. The lottery jackpot gives a server-wide game message stating it was won, but does not tell exactly who won
  • Ranked duels spawn an invisible arena. When reaching the edge of this arena, it starts to glow red. Leaving the bubble will cause a forfeit. This can be abused in duels vs. mages because they will throw a corrupt - leave the arena while corrupted and they will go grey from damaging a "blue"
  • Supply goods/crates give more supply the further one travels from the town to the TC structure. 3 supply is gained per 100m travelled, for a maximum of 300 supply per crate
  • Thursar's "Lifesteal" clade gift is disabled against passive AI such as TC NPCs. It is intended to work vs. players and their pets, or hostile mobs

blocks.html:
• Pets that are abandoned or traded while they are eating continue to eat, even for new owners.

You can dry fire siege weapons to eat their durability. Manganons can be destroyed from 100% by dry firing rapidly 100 times.

  • Relic waves (white beam meteors) drop an polyhedron from their final boss. This polyhedron corresponds to a god within the MO2 universe. The specific god listed determines what spawns when the polyhedron is placed. For example, the god Mors (death) spawns undead.
  • Mind blast is the purest form of damage. It is not reduced by any effect/defense except for the necromancy akh bond spell. This includes going through magic defense potions. The only other way to counter this spells damage is equalizing strength and intelligence.
  • Akh bond is the purest form of damage mitigation. No matter the damage source it will transfer the damage from the player to the bonded pet. This includes fall damage and the mind blast spell.
  • The required taming level for horses is a minimum of 1. If your character has taming unlocked by not enough bonus to be higher than level 0, you cannot tame a horse and you must gain 1 level.
  • Going AFK in a dungeon automatically kills the player after 2 hours. Being AFK as a ghost will force a the ghost to the nearest priest.

blocks.html:
• When there are no reds online and you try to pull a bounty, an error message of "There are no available contracts right now." will display.

The PHYSICAL portion of elementalism damage is reduced by the armor value of your set /5. So if you have 5 pieces of armor with 50 blunt defense, that averages out to 50 blunt defense vs. blunt ele spells.

  • Player head weight is determined by the race of the player. Alvarin heads are 3.8kg, Thursars are 5.1kg, Human are 4.6kg, and Oghmir are 5.4kg.
  • Speed loss for mount equipment weight is approximately 4.1 speed per kg of weight.
  • Guilds can only be wardeck'd if they are hosting TWO murderers or more.
  • Wardecs can only be surrendered after 48 hours of it being live.

Allying a guild takes 30 minutes before it kicks in.

blocks.html:
• Wardec flag takes precedence over red flag. This means a player in an enemy guild who is also red cannot be attacked with criminal actions turned off. If they attack the red with crim actions on, it initiates the war combatant status and guards will defend the red.

The "+healing when low HP" orb only affects magic healing. It does NOT affect styganthrope, potions, bandages, nor passive regen.

  • All bandit heads drop as "human" with 4.6kg weight, even if they are not human bandits.
  • Bow consume 0.1 durability each time an arrow hits a valid target. Missing a shot does not consume durability. Executing through mercy also does not use durability.
  • Mounted magery penalty only applies when the spell is cast from the mount. This means charging a spell and then dismounting does not receive the penalty- and the inverse is true: if you charge a spell and then mount it will be receive the mounted penalty.
  • Setting a "home priest" doesn't actually link you to that priest. It simply saves your XYZ coordinates and teleports you to that location. If you bind to a priest that is destroyed, it still teleports you to that location.
  • The flat compass is the default setting and will show you the location of the nearest task objectives. If using the (legacy) round compass, you do not get the same information. If using the round compass, toggle to the flat compass if you need guidance on the bearing and distance of objectives.

blocks.html:
• Tasks which require pickables can both be done by directly picking the item in the world, but also by picking up something that contains the pickable. The most famous example of this is Karoton coming from naturist satchels.

Accessing the public test realm (PTR) requires a subbed account.

  • Necromancer walkers die when the controller's mana hits 0.
  • Combatant flags such as grey and orange invisibly confer to the mount a player is on. This explicitly means that if a blue player has a grey passenger, their horse will count as grey to guards and can be shot by them.
  • When altering a siege timer, the value you enter adds onto the current timer. Adding 24:00 pushes it back 24 hours, and doesn't set it to midnight.
  • Supply towers give 3 supply per 30 minutes. Each 1 supply is worth 1g of transactions at a TC building. 10% of the value of each transaction is added to the guild treasury. The supply cap for each guild (default 1000), can be raised by leveling a guild by capturing towers and spending prominence in the guild tab.
  • While bow effectiveness drops at 20%, it is not a flat reduction that occurs from 20% to 0%. It progressively loses weapon damage the more dura is lost over time. This likely works for melee weapons, but testing only covered bows.

• When in ghost mode, you can hear but not see relic meteors

Converting currency (gold -> silver, silver -> gold) on a TC vendor does not consume supply.

  • Etherworld portals totally block Alvarin sight through them.

  • Outpost banks hold a max of 20 items, but they can be expanded with 20 capacious bags for a total of 320 items

  • Server restarts, even if they are caused by a crash, refresh the daily tasks
  • The Tagmaton "web pull" ability triggers defensive stance XP gain, even though no damage is dealt. This possibly means other non-damage abilities have this same property.
