Location: A farm POI NE of the keep in Tindremic Midlands

Title: N/A

Text:

I love my husband with all of my heart, but this venture of his was nothing short of foolish.

He wished for us to reclaim a small village abandoned by his great grandfather, yet none of us have an upbringing or education in farming. He claimed it would be easy, that “if the uneducated provincials can make their living farming, then surely we can too.”

But I am not so confident, we were both born to stone walls and paved streets, as were the slaves we brought with us. We know the trials and challenges of navigating a city and its many characters, not the wilderness that becomes as still as death in the pitch black night.

After raising my concerns that the slaves quarters look much like our own, he assured me that the collapsed building on the other side of the garden is what we will be living in once it’s remade into a beautiful villa.

I must admit it would be quite the remarkable home after living in an insula our entire marriage. The children have even dragged a chest there and started to pretend as if the structure is already complete and we’re already living inside.

But I fear that they will be disappointed. Such an endeavor may take months or years. And where will the money come from?

One of the slaves returned to us out of breath, exclaiming that the fortress to the north has a group of outlaws living inside.

I refuse to stay here any longer.

If my husband wishes to risk his safety and our very livelihood on his stubbornness, fine. But I will not risk the childrens’ lives, or my own, on his confidence. I am taking them with me and heading to the city in the morning.

It became an argument, he promised he would be able to send for the guards before the outlaws even realize we’re here.

But what if they already know?

After my last entry, I have decided to leave my journal here.

I know you will be reading this and trying to understand why I have chosen to leave. Read my own words, when I thought no one else would see them.

I have not abandoned you, only this place.

When you wish to return to us, we will be in the city.

Your wife,

Larisa

community collaboration. players are permitted to submit notes/books/readable lore bits from around this game in this section. it requires a specific format. use the listed format so entries remain searchable and consistent. you will include the location of the lore, the title at the top of the lore (if applicable), and the full text written out in its entirety. a picture must be included and cropped. before posting a submission, go to the search bar and type "in:lore-notes text" to make sure you are not double posting. see: format - location: [be as specific as possible] title: [the top bolded text of the work, if it exists] text: [the full text of the lore note] picture: [crop it, please] the player with the most correctly formatted submissions gets the @loremaster title, which grants access to the patron chat and articles sections. this title can be stolen! location: fabernum west bank on the wall. title: seeking mercenaries to kill rats! text: i cannot offer coin, as my pockets are tied up in other, more important matters. but what i can offer you is whatever you may loot from the ruins these rats have taken up residence in. i tried to live with them, i promise on my mother's grave that i did. i gave them their space, i sought no quarrel with them. and yet, they have begun to raid my storage shed! i realize i hadn't accounted for the fact that they have thumbs, so i did what anyone reasonably would do and hired a locksmith to seal the food shed. so what did they do? why, they dug right beneath the shed! my requirement is that you are gifted in a martial art or offensive magics. i will not pay anyone to collect your body if you're foolish enough to fight them without proper training and equipment! they can be found in the lesser used mountain road to the west of fabernum, in the destroyed fort overlooking the tower below. location: on the table in front of the sewer king boss room in the fabernum sewers. title: by proclamation of the king! text: a stew competition will be held today, the winner will be allowed to attend dinner with the king himself, and his royal consort, where we will discuss future opportunities in the castle. location: on the table in front of the sewer king boss room in the fabernum sewers. title: by proclamation of the queen! text: the former king's execution will be held tomorrow, all must atted. location: outside pathfinder shinarian labrynth boss room: title: none text: the ruins are even more magnificent than i had anticipated. every step deeper into these ancient hallways reveals more about our history. their craftsmanship is unparalleled; the stonework, the inscriptions, and the very air seem to hum with latent power. my followers and i have uncovered numerous artifacts, each more intriguing than the last. there is a resonance here, a sense of purpose that permeates these walls. i can feel it in my bones. the shinarians were more than just builders-- they were visionaries, and their secrets lie just beyond our grasp. the door sealed behind us, and i take that as a sign that we are on the right path. this place has been untouched for centuries, waiting for someone with the will and wisdom to unlock its mysteries. i am here now. a few of the others have been restless, but i assure them that our perserverance will be rewarded. the usual promises of filled pockets once we return home are satisfying them at least for now. there is much to study, and time is a luxury we must afford ourselves. i only hope those on the surface can remain patient and keep their focus on the mission at hand. these ruins speak to me. they tell of a civilization that harnessed power beyond our understanding. i must learn their secrets. it is my duty, my destiny, to uncover the truth and to wield the knowledge they left behind. location: recreant mini boss topside of labs dungeon, bottom key part title: none text: the situation has spiraled out of control. the pathfinder led the rest below, leaving us to fend for ourselves out here. if you ask me, the conflict was unavoidable. now, the key is broken, and so is our group i hold one of the pieces, a burden i never asked for. the other two both seek to restore the key but i think for vastly different reasons. one wants to free our leader, blinded by loyalty. the other loud one just seeks power for themself even if they deny it me? i just want to survive. i fear what lies below and i fear what our leader might do if they are freed once they see what happened. the pathfinder's wrath is not something i wish to face. i've seen what they are capable of, and its enough to make any sane person hesitate. the others view me as a coward, but they dont understand the weight of my decision. i refuse to be dragged into their power struggle. i will hide my piece of the key and avoid their conflict. let them tear each other part if they must all i want is to escape this cursed ruin and return home. but for now, i must bide my time and stay out of their way the key remains divided and so does our fate. location: sidonian loyalist, middle key part title: none text: the situation here grows more dire by the hour. the fight that erupted after the pathfinder descended below has left us in a pitiful state. the key, our only means of reopening the door, now lies broken into three pieces, each held by a fool who thinks their way is best its infuriating to see grown warriors acting like children, squabbling over pieces of metal while our leader remains trappe below. their cowardice and ambition alike have blinded them to our true purpose i remain steadfast in my loyalty to the pathfinder. we must reunite the key and free our leader. the knowledge and treasures they must have uncovered below are too valuable to be lost to petty infighting. i will continue to watch and wait for an opportunity to reclaim the pieces and restore our mission. the others may have forgotten their purpose but i have not. our leader needs us and i will see this through, no matter the cost location: north morin khur (mk) sewer entrance, at the bottom of the long stairs title: none text: there has been an increase in criminal activity throughout the tunnels that is to the concern of any who might travel them. many of these outlaws wish to remain hidden and are a part of dangerous organizations. all who walk beyond this point should have a guard accompanying them at all times in order to ensure their safety. location: just before the drop-down to the "red" section of morin khur (mk) sewers, located on the way to the drug den. title: go no further! text: by the order of the head of the ugiyan urland, the platform to the level below as been removed. if you choose to pass this barrier, it is highly likely you will encounter dangerous individuals who have climbed up from the ravine, away from the watchful eye of the guards of morin khur. should you find yourself below this point, you must cross the ravine to the south and climb up the sewers in the slums to return to the city. location: morin khur (mk) sewers, on the way to the drug den just past the turn off towards the drop down to the red area, in front of a closed door. title: dawa, text: togtuun has given me enough trouble to last three lifetimes, so this will be the last time i trade my family’s pillows and fabrics. i’ve sworn it many times, but i am serious about this one. i’m not going back in there again. i can’t help but feel the way i do, my father died in that place. his body was never even brought to us to be given to the sky. every time he sees me, togtuun pesters me. calls me "little girl" when i am older than he is! i try to measure the disrespect he is willing to place on my name, and yet it grows. he disrespects my father and calls him an addict. my father was no addict, he was merely in unimaginable pain. i pray togtuun finds himself laying on one of those mats one day. you may tell him i said that. – saikhan location: morin khur (mk) sewers, inside the alchemy/necromancy lab title: observations, week two text: many who are curious about the vast darkness that exists below us know of the lichen-like growths that grow from the walls of many caverns. to our people, it is known as “tark’s breath”, as it seems highly averse to the sun’s light, and yet where the growths are found the air remains sweet and breathable. most kinds are indistinguishable from plain gray and brown granum, but i have heard from a sheevra that occasionally they are different colors. it would seem deep fungi grow best in areas of particularly thick growths of tark’s breath. it is not exactly a common thing to find on the surface, and as such, i have had much difficulty growing full caps from the spores that have recently been brought to me. the glowing worms of the deep seem to match the glow of the mushrooms presented to them. i do not know if this is because they eat it, or if they can identify the correct color to hide from predators. several have spun cocoons, which i did not expect. i wonder what they will become with time? location: morin khur (mk) sewers, inside the alchemy/necromancy lab title: none text: it would seem we truly do have a problem with the rats that walk on two legs. the sightings have become more and more frequent. even i have heard something large scuttling in the pipes above my workspace. i give my those who spend more time down here claim that there is some tunnel that they seem to often emerge from. were it not so dangerous, i would attempt to explore it myself. location: morin khur (mk) sewers, inside the alchemy/necromancy lab title: none text: like many of the bodies i receive, these two are gravely thin. i have yet to perfect these particular rituals. ana’dil is not a tongue familiar to me, and i have neither sarducaans nor bediai to help me translate. if i am performing the rituals correctly, key parts of it remain incomplete. i have heard legends of kebechet cultists roaming the sands of sarducaa, existing as impossible-to-track mobile husks who have truly bested death and even kept some semblance of their wits about them. if i were to find an immortal, surely it would be a sarducaan. i wonder often what state of a being that is. absolutely no depiction of immortality attained through necromancy is ever described as painless or graceful. surely there is some truth to that, and if they truly do exist and hide so thoroughly… perhaps it is for a reason? location: lab dungeon top key title: none text: i had hoped it wouldnt come to this, but our leader descent into the ruin was the perfect time to act. the pathfinder's pursuit of power and knowledge threatens us all. it was clear to me that a change was necessary and now i know i wasnt alone in that belief. when the others had gone below, i seized the moment to speak out. i tried to make them see reason, to understand that following our leader's reckless path would us to ruin. but reason is a rare commodity among warriors driven by ambition and fear. the fight that followed was inevitable. in the chaos, the damn key shattered into three pieces, each claimed by those who see a different path going forward. that blind loyalist clings to the past, while the other coward hides i, however see the truth. we must confront that pathfinder, not as followers, but as equals, or challengers if need be. i will gather those who share my vision. we will restoer the key not to free the pathfinder but to face them and make them see the error of their ways. if they refuse we will do what must be done location: book found along the northwest wall of the first chamber in the ignis cavern. title: the crystal cave by elie amatas text: talusain legend tells of a cavern in the mountains where beings were born from clusters of rock and crystal, living simple existences separate from the complex lives of humans and oghmir. even plants took easily to the place, witnessed in bundles of ferns and grass on the floors and walls among the glittering gems and oddly-patterned stones. one summer day smoke billowed from the cave, creating a gloom in the skies for weeks that made bears slumber as if it was winter and nightsnatchers crawl from their dens during the day. it is said the first one to brave the cave and set foot inside only shortly after it settled was a huergar concerned about the elementals within. her grandmother had told her of a time when the place only sang with the songs of crystal, a chime that never seemed to cease so much as shift its pitch up and down—but never having a beginning or reaching an end. she told her of impossibly sharp crystal things that looked like glass, that knew not the fragility of beings made of skin and blood. whether through maliciousness, ignorant playfulness, or immoral curiosity—they would shred any being made of flesh into ribbons. the cavern wasn't safe then, but the thunder eggs were plentiful, and so many were lost trying to retrieve them. through her, she had heard other tales. her grandmother personally attested to the existence of a pleasant dirt-clod thing that ambled about inoffensively and without danger. she described to her how it would gather mounds of dirt like a child pulling a pile of sand or snow onto themselves when trying to cover their torso, but doing so made itself larger and larger over the years it was observed. she even spoke of a thing that had come from an underground pond of water. it glistened magnificently in the combination of torchlight and crystal before it sank back in, completely disappearing from sight when fully submerged. the crystal cave painted to her by her grandmother in tales was a place of wonder, danger, and mystery; but she grandmother had not mentioned the thing of rock and fire that half-slithered from a pool of magma, melting the half-submerged body of the kimurus she had come to cherish. there was now heat in the crystal cave. location: cave south of toxai, east of necro dungeon on map. title: none text: brothers, do not enter this place. inside you will only find death, old and new. i escaped only by following the tindremenes' every order as they descended into madness. they made contact with an old evil, a buried spirit that speaks in dreams. he sings in the voice of one of the tribes, though i cannot understand his tongue. yes, a shaman cursed this place long ago! i barely escaped with my life, flinging myself from a bridge into a chasm below, a bridge they intended to collapse and replace with something else. the fools saved me by cushioning my fall with piles of gore beneath me! i sang do not enter this place. location: morin khur south side entrance to task givers title: citizens of morin khur text: for several weeks there has been an increase in the activity of tribe rats. although the guard has dealt with the ones we have found we advise caution in the future in areas that are dark and unfrequented, such it alone. where the is one, there will likely be many more. instead, report your findings to a guard. as always, please share and spread this information. those who cannot read must also be informed of this threat. location: behind sylvan sanctum rustic armor book vendor title: none text: if one of you wretches finds this, take it to your leader at once. yes, we have been aware of your presence for some time now. the only reason i haven't had my mecenaries track you down and kill you is because you and your little friends have yet to directly interfere with our research. at least that were true until this morning, when we found some of our equipment had not so mysteriously gone missing during the night. take this as a kidness, collect your loud footed oafs and leave this place at once. immediately. the mast shivered, striking some of them with debris as well. they retreated further down the coast, surely to survey and return later. most of the population from the village further up huddled next to a chest of my things that i dragged up the broken staircase. i know i will have to leave it behind, i just hope those bastards don't find it first. location: abandoned/pillaged village covered in eggs that will hatch and eat me alive. i may just travel to that village to the north to ask them if they've had any trouble with arachnids as of late. location: on the table of an open house near a blainn vendor in the "miners village" poi (red priest location) west-northwest of fabernum. title: n/a text: the more time i spend here, the more i believe this was the right choice. it is a small village, and not much happens here. things are logical, predictable, regular, and boring. that is a blessing in times like these, and i am thankful for it every day. at one point in my life i had believed it better to perhaps search for an isolated settlement of my people. i wished to chase the exciting notion that both sides of the oghmir clade could reclaim some of the ruins in the mountains and make them into a proper settlement. a true home, where we can live true to our customs without being pestered about our ways of life. but there is comfort in familiarity and, with risk of sounding stereotypical, i simply do not enjoy change. i may be an oghmir, but i am also a fabernumite, and the humans who share this place with us are kind enough. this is far away enough from the noise of the city, and it will do for now. location: fabernum inn, 3rd floor, book on the northwest bed. title: n/a text: how i yearn for the company of scholars and intellectuals. instead, i am trapped here, in this town where few understand my desires and interests. father would rather have me work my fingers to the bone in a mine shaft as he does, and his father did, and his father's father's father did. does he not see that i have no interest in these affairs? i do not wish to be a miner, or a woodcutter, or a huntsman, or a smith. i want to be an alchemist! a scholar! a man of knowledge! mother has discussed with him about sending me to tindrem for a year to stay with my uncle faustus, but i know that i am doomed to stay here. location: tindrem arena, south red room, note on a table. title: n/a text: dear tupor, the first time i saw you fight in the arena, you immediately caught my eye. i leaned over to my friend who asked me who the tall and handsome one is, and she said you were brought from the outskirts of meduli as a bandit... is that correct? well, i can tell, even from afar, that you are simply misunderstood, likely pushed into the circumstances you found yourself in without much choice. i have many suitors, my mother says it is because of my looks, but they do not see who i truly am. but i know in my heart that you and i are kindred spirits, and that you would understand me and cherish me as i want to be cherished. during your next match, i will be wearing a bright red stola parted down to my waist, and i will be waving a red fan of the same color. look for me tupor, i will be there! location: tindrem library entrance chamber, book on a south-side desk or fabernum library, 2nd floor on a table. title: the nameless statues of tindrem by tectio da levita text (pt. 1): one who spends any amount of time int he marvelous city of tindrem cannot escape the brilliance of figures made of marble. tragically, some of these figures lack plaques to denote who or what they are meant to commemorate. as one would expect of such inventive and passionate people, the citizens of tindrem have given each a story. some are well-regarded enough to boast multiple! the sage the statue commonly known as the sage is rumored to be the statue of a great thinker of the clerus magica, an academy that sank into the sea only a few short generations ago. while few tindremenes are alive today to have experienced the academy in its glory, the organization itself and its great thinkers and inventors glitter brightly among the many stars that light the sky of tindrem's past. another rumor surrounding the sage is that he was a great scholar and philosopher, who brought knowledge to the people of tindrem from far-away lands. perhaps an ancient provinciale, bringing his most valuable information to the capital? could he have been from the ruined city of gabaria, now known as gaul'kor? some around tindrem believe so! the tantalizing promise of knowledge from lands far and wide have long captured imaginations of our people, proof of our adoration for knowledge, exploration, and ambition. location: tindrem library entrance chamber, book on a south-side desk or fabernum library, 2nd floor on a table. title: the nameless statues of tindrem by tectio da levita text (pt. 2): the grieving woman despite lacking a name on her statues, what is known about her would suggest that she was born in fabernum. it is uncertain how her life took her to the fortified island between myrland and sarducaa, but most are certain that her story took her there. in the most common retelling, an unprecedentedly large group of nordeveldian pirates attacked the island, abandoning crudely made rats and allowing them to be whisked below tecton's fault. tragically, her mother and father were slain in their bedchambers, and then the woman and her husband were brought before the pirates' leader. despite her pleas, her husband was beheaded, and his head was given to her after she begged the kallard to give him back to her. it is believed that she sat with his head in a prison cell in the dungeon of the fortress for weeks before the island was retaken by the empire. another entirely different story claims that she was the sister of a decapitated member of the tricapita, cradling her brother's head in her arms one last time. was this perhaps the result of a plot for power all along and she merely kissed her brother's forehead to sway those into believing her innocent, or was she truly grieving? some even go so far as to say she was the mistress of a decapitated emperor, which would make her perhaps the most famous, although nameless, mistress in all of tindremic history. all versions of the story are explicit about one thing, however: the woman believed that so long as she kept the man's head, she could hear his spirit talking to her. was this madness, or proof that love transcends even death? location: tindrem plaza tavern, 2nd floor, note on a desk in the hallway. title: bounty: outlaws wanted text: outlaws have raided the home of a provinciale of tindrem, bloodying husband and wife. both were kept hostage for days before the couple was able to escape. workers from the nearby farm have reported that the home in the woods has been partially destroyed. if any would like to bring vengeance to these miscreants, travel south along the road out of tindrem until you reach a signpost that points to both meduli and tindrem and a fork in the road to the southeast. travel along this road until you find the orchards. once you are in front of the two buildings in the western portion of these orchards, head into the woods to your immediate southwest. may astraia's light accompany you on your path to justice! location: tindrem tindrem plaza tavern, 2nd floor, first room, note on a dresser. title: a guide to visiting tindrem by byronos corii text (pt. 1): this is the first installment of my series of books: "a guide to visiting tindrem: for provincales and others". if you are reading this book then you wish to be prepared to participate in the bountiful glories and opportunities that the capital of tindremic society can offer to an outsider. it is true what you have heard: tindrem and her people are complex and multi-facted, as is to be expected of any highly advanced society. an outsider may feel shocked and overwhelmed, unsure how to proceed or who to trust for a helping hand. it is for these unfortunate souls i have written this book, so that it may serve as a guiding hand in an uncertain place. chapter 1: first steps it is imperative during your first few months in tindrem to be keenly aware of your surroundings. the risk comes not from pickpockets or other petty thieves but instead may approach you in the form of liars, vagrants, and opportunists who would exploit you for all you're worth. you may be approached by a strikingly beautiful woman with hair the color of nyx falling in perfect coils around her face dressed like a beggar in need, or you may see a pitiable old man who seems to be ignored as he lays on the side of the road in what surely are his last breaths. both are the descriptions of individuals who have been arrested for crimes against newcomers to this grand city. although the city guard do what they can to round up these individuals, the greatest grandeur draws in the low lives like moths to a flame. location: tindrem tindrem plaza tavern, 2nd floor, first room, note on a dresser. title: a guide to visiting tindrem by byronos corii text (pt. 2): to protect yourself, you should appear confident as if you know where you are going. do not wander aimlessly staring at things the average citizen would not think to notice. approach your destination with intent, and any who observe you will assume you have been here before. although tempting, speaking with the guards stationed near the gate is another way to be quickly identified and tracked. if marked by one of such individuals, they may follow you for quite some time—particularly if you seem rather wealthy or well-connected. if you are unsure if you are being followed or not, you should make nonsensical paths, such as walking in a circle around several buildings. if the individual in question is still behind you when you complete this circle, you can assume you are being followed. i must add that this plan is not foolproof by any means. many pickpockets operate in small packs that may communicate your description with other members. the most common pickpocket group tactic is where one will get in your way so you're forced to suddenly stop, and another from behind will bump into you as if it was your fault. when you check your pockets after, however, you may very well find your coin purse missing. be mindful of obvious distractions such as someone shouting or asking you to read a map or letter for them. location: morin khur slums, northeastern-most building, a note posted on its door. title: n/a text: galdai, i have gotten word you have been insulting my sister and her spouse. all know this is because you thought she was beautiful and wanted her to be yours. she is not, and you will let her live free of your abuse. this behavior of yours will end one way or another. if you wish to settle this between us, meet me and apologize. then meet with my sister, and apologize to her. then meet with her spouse, and apologize to him. then stand before my tribe, and apologize to them. bayage location: book found on the ground, south side of the first chamber in the ignis cavern. title: n/a text: finding the cave was no simple task, but the book was right. there's many more crystals down here than i expected, and she didn't mention they glow. thankfully none of those "crystal things" the author mentioned, but i do hear a faint rumbling. maybe it's more like gurgling. likely not them though. i hope. it's got to be those things the huergar talked about. "heat has entered the crystal cave." are the "things of rock and fire" just another one of those infuriating huergar poeticisms, or is there something to it? i'll be careful either way, it's not as if i can't simply sprint out of here if i meet any trouble. location: on the ground up the large slope south of toxai towards the temple town, below a small bandit camp note: there used to be a corpse here with the note, implying the note holder was thrown off the cliff - seems removed title: khudai text: meet me at the top of the ridge behind the mountain village. some of our new friends wish to talk to us. location: east of mino dungeon approximately 1km in the mountains title: none text: the khurite returned to the campfire today believing he saw a risar. i suppose the location matches, does it not? still, i do not believe that this should discontinue our search for the white bear. we already agreed to look the other way concerning those ruins to the southwest, did we not? location: the necro dungeon library. title: the colors of blood by irius albius + erythroheme - red blood text: in any field documenting the natural world itself, categorization is of both the utmost concern of the research to better understand the properties and behaviors of a subject and is simultaneously the vexation of any scholar who studies their subject thoroughly. it is a simple truth that things not artificially created to be perfectly organized will never align as well as many would like to think, with perhaps the exception of mathematics. as a sanguinist, i have seen and attempted to interpret different kinds of blood for much of my lifetime. the blood of a bovine and the blood of a human are certainly different, yet when merely observed in a glass bottle they are impossible to distinguish. this is not the case for many creatures in the world, and i postulate that there is value in first noting the visual appeance of blood types, which often share common qualities and components based on said appearence. from there, one can then define their specific qualities and origins. using this method, i would propose we can categorize blood by its color; red, blue, green, purple, clear, yellow, and perhaps even the color amber. [next page] as all individuals who may read this book are almost certainly red blooded, it would be naive to assume that red blood, which is to say our own blood, would be described as anything other than "blood". even so, for categorical purposes, i believe it important to have a technical name, even if it is one purely used by scholars and practicioners who require discernment between different kinds of blood. the properties of erythroheme are perhaps the best understood of all blood colors, as it is the most often encountered by us in large quantities. all creatures with a backbone, with the exception of a small number of fish, have red blood. this includes birds, reptiles, mammals, amphibians, and most fish; as well as some species of worm and leech. red blood has been used for millenia in medicine, cooking, ritual, and as an alchemical and spell casting reagent. it either seems to propagate, or propagate from, the bones and other similar structures of creatures with backbones. it is observed as uniquely in some way tied to the very concept of a skeleton, though not exclusively. while it has been postulated that red blood creates a skeleton in the creature it flows in, the existence of worms and leeches with red blood would imply that instead perhaps the skeleton which makes red blood, or makes blood red.  location: oghmium lore cave title: n/a text: i told that half-wit that there was nothing of worth down along that shore, but he will do what he wants to do. i've never shifted his mind on these things. it looks like i was right, once again. i've found a wrecked huergar underway by following hearsay after hearsay across the talus. many of the things folk told me were somewhat untrue, if not wholly wrong. amongst the things i've looked through here, there have been several books about "oghmium". any wisdom on how to craft it is hard to find. the huergar and tindremenes both hide anything and everything having to do with it, so it should be able to fetch a lot of coin. but what would make me more coin are "thunder eggs". a tind wrote to me, hearing of my many treks across the peaks and through the grottos of the talus as of late. he said if i can gather him many of these rocks, he will be able to make me rich. now all i must do is find some, or one who knows where to get some. location: bakti tavern, in the wall left of the soldier meet together tonight to discuss how we might even begin to track them. we have all of the signs of a return of the two-legged lizards. if i am right, they may have been taken captive if they were not killed. location: fabernum to the southwest, a note on wooden cages next to a chopping block. title: logging report text: we completed the work as requested, one hundred and ten logs for the text: day 28 we hear the howling of wolves every night. the attacks are becoming more frequent. i've told the men to travel in groups of two or larger when leaving the camps. day 29 we finally killed one of the things, gorm managed to catch it in the neck with a pickaxe. he pointed out that it had a closed stitch on its leg. is it a pack of loose wolves someone was trying to tame doing this? day 30 most of the others have already left, we're considering abandoning this place and doing the same. i would rather face the wrath of an upset nobilita than whoever may be lurking in those trees and their attack dogs. location: morin khur north broker building, bookshelf on the north side. title: the stone wall of herabalter by surentai of morin khur text (pt. 1): this book has been approved by the tindremic literary council of morin khur. for as long as our people have spoken of herabalter, the wall built by the risar bordering the ashen land was a wooden palisade. it was a great wall made of logs, with wooden spikes at its base where the dead bodies of those slain by the risar could be found. over the last century it has become a stone wall. this seems to have happened after the swarm of the terrible insects that dug through the earth and flew through the skies. before then, any who neared this palisade would meet their death at the hands of the risar. it was reported some decades ago that there was a strange development in this place between myrland and herabalter: a stone wall was being created. at first it was assumed this wall would be cobblestone, an extension of the rocks that surrounded the base of the wooden palisade. over time, however, the rumors of this wall became more clear. it was an impressive structure made of great stone blocks and stone spikes that stretched towards the sky like the fangs of a serpent. the risar had developed the practice of building towers while none were watching. this was, and is, a great concern. too many think them to be simple, aggressive creatures incapable of intelligent thought and advanced planning. they are seen as bloodthirsty monsters who only wish to hunt, kill, ravage, and cause torment. a species of raiders and bandits, and little more. this is a false belief. we would do well to remember that the risar are capable of speech. they have cultural practices, some not entirely like those of humans. their women will abandon their thursar children in our villages and khurens while we are fast asleep, knowing they will have a better life among us than the hard life of the risar. location: morin khur north broker building, bookshelf on the north side. title: the stone wall of herabalter by surentai of morin khur text (pt. 2): it would be wise of us to consider the possibility that more is happening beyond the wall than we have historically witnessed from the risar. they may have built cities out of the land where volcanic pools bubble and ashes partially block the sun, turning the atmosphere a dreary shade of green. they may have risar kings and risar queens who command the other risar, instructing them to fortify the the wall to myrland and punish those who do not fall in line. some would say that i am foolish and that it is only a wall and nothing more. i ask any who contain any doubt within themselves to look upon the sketches made of the structure. it is the work of sophisticated minds and it is built with undisclosed but clear intention and purpose. we must keep a close eye on our neighbors. location: morin khur, spiritism trader building, north bookshelf title: tribes of the east by bemius amaterna text (pt. 1): this book has been approved by the tindremic literary council of morin khur. morin khur has existed for quite some time as something of an anomaly among the khurite people. while the tribes of the forests and steppes wander myrland mixing their cultures and intermingling with one another, the tribes of morin khur and toxai are rather stationary. it is little wonder that both became places where nomadic tribes will also occasionally gather, considering the reliability of their presence. with settlement comes the need for farming, such as rice in morin khur and seaweed in toxai. with farming, if done properly, comes excess and the ability to better store more food in case of drought, famine, or some other such disaster. the tribes of the two cities reflect this change in culture quite naturally, reflecting those seen in many other settled societies. the people themselves still highly prize physical skills such as horse riding and swimming, but there is also value placed on adherence to laws and social order that is less "free" than those found in khurens. while exile remains a common punishment, imprisonment, enslavement, and fines are also popular. executions are unique in that the khurs are severely hesitant to spill blood on the ground. their methods of disposing criminals are thus rather inventive, such as rolling one up in a carpet and then having him be trampled by horses, tying one up and throwing them in a river, or locking them in a box and leaving them to be subjected to the elements. wrestling matches are another form of execution, where an executioner will engage in a fight with the offender. the executioner is invariably a large man, sometimes a thursar, who is strong enough to break someone's back over their knee. location: morin khur, spiritism trader building, north bookshelf title: tribes of the east by bemius amaterna text (pt. 2): typically multiple steps are taken to ensure the executioner will win, including giving them armor while the offender fights in rags. often the offender is purposefully paralyzed and left for dead so that a natural sky burial may take place. this same practice is often not extended to those who are not khurs. but the people of morin khur are not only their executions, and despite their infamy they make up a rather small portion of their culture. angaqs here are typically not solitary members of their tribes as they often are when found riding the steppes. though especially small tribes may have only one angaq, most have multiple who may even live in certain homes together. the unique cultural expectations of the city have even allowed for temples, where their shamans may learn, worship, and perform their rites among other like minded individuals. it is not uncommon for a resident of morin khur in need of spiritual or magical assistance to visit a temple in the city. location: fabernum tavern, 2nd floor, north table title: the stone folk of fabernum by sirio miserenna text: the stone folk have long been a part of fabernum's history. before they retreated beneath the mountain, huergar are said to have frequented the town. it was the huergar that the people here learned the specific methods of refining and smelting that fabernum is now famous for. after the conflux, several families of huergar decided to stay on fabernum instead of joining their brethren in retreating to the world below. although outsiders who know little of the huergar would paint them as a monolith, there are many divisions of thought and mannerisms among them even when considering the huergar found in fabernum in comparison to those found in tindrem. the huergar in fabernum, although they hold their own values and reside in their own community, tend to be less involved in social climbing than those in tindrem. many are quite content to live as the fabernumites do, focusing on their crafts and what they can offer to the provinces and the communities around them. historically, there was also a small trickle of blainn from their settlement of old hyllspeia up in the talus mountains. although their influence was small, it can be felt in the small injection of nordveldian names specifically inspired by the blainn tongue of lisan ki. most, however, follow the principles of lisan abnu, the huergar dialect. location: vadda library, book on the northwest table title: n/a text: i was taken seven years ago by the tindremenes as a slave. for those seven years i worked in meduli under a nobilita named petrios. he was blind. i learned to read and write for him. i felt pity for the old man. i could have left easily. i did not. i escaped across the plains when he died of his old age. when i returned to vadda my tribe had long left. i will wait here for a time. word of my tribe will reach vadda soon enough. i will help the people here until then. there is much knowledge to be found in these books. location: forum tindrem, first building south of the arena district gate, 2nd floor title: autumnal celebrations in tindrem text (pt. 1): autumn is a time of harvests, and we would be fools to not partake in the many gifts from the gods! join me, camulocus di somniati, on a journey through the many festivals and activities you may choose to participate in during this season! wine festival of red leaves the wine festival of red leaves is held nearly every year, and has no specific day it is held. instead, the people wait patiently for the leaves of the trees planted around certain vineyards to redden and become vibrant. tents and tables are quickly brought to the villas surrounding the vineyards, where the winemaking families traditionally host a great feast in honor of the leaves changing color. and what would a feast at a winemaker's villa be without wine? to receive an invitation to the festivities, to be sure either extent your interest (if you happen to be a nobilita), or perhaps offer your services as an attendant of the feast if you are not. the families have plenty of slaves between them who are more than capable of handling the more arduous tasks, leaving you the lighter and more social work. i have spoken to many who have found work at the feasts there, from courtesans, to musicians, to servers of food and pourers of wine. they are always given generous amounts of time to participate as well, so reliably that it has become tradition. location: forum tindrem, first building south of the arena district gate, 2nd floor title: autumnal celebrations in tindrem text (pt. 2): the haunting of the fields this particular game happens at night, and can be quite thrilling! the story behind this celebration is ancient, originating from a small farming village out in the heartlands of tindrem. it is said that a powerful venefica from the surrounding woodlands was executed in an especially brutal manner after poisoning a well-loved man of the village. it was only after her death that it was revealed that he had rightfully earned his demise. it is said that after her death, her spirit still roams the fields, seeking to subject any she may encounter to the same tortures she endured. the game itself involves a woman, deemed the "venefica" of the night, who is given two chances to win. first, she must flee those chosen to represent "villagers", who will chase her through a field with lanterns. her goal is technically to remain hidden for as long as possible, though it is rare the venefica won't allow herself to be found. this is because once she is caught, a small ceremony will be held where everyone will dine on malus fruit and various desserts, drinks, and sweets made from the fruit. once they are full and have let their meals settle, the villagers are then sent out into the fields, where the "venefica" will chase after them. if every last villager is caught before an hourglass settles and a horn is blown, another ceremony is held where the villagers ask her for their forgiveness. location: forum tindrem, first building south of the arena district gate, 2nd floor title: autumnal celebrations in tindrem text (pt. 3): the choice to forgive them is, of course, up to the mood of the venefica of the night. there are three accepted speeches: one where she accepts their plea, allowing everyone to go home as they were. the second is where she denies their plea, and the revelers who lost have the "i" of an interfector painted on their foreheads with a pigment meant to dye their skin for several days. the third choice is for her to choose for them to be her walking dead servants, who must not speak and obey every order she gives. location: forum tindrem, first building south of the arena district gate, 2nd floor title: autumnal passages, is that why they have been employed here? are these great stone arches symbolic for some purpose, can they be used to pass from one place to another? what came first, the mesmerizing meduli's warm embraces by teucerios condos text: the city of meduli has long been known as a place of many delights, and though the seaside harbor town has yet to fully recover from the travesties of the irruption, it is still known to this day for its bordellos and courtesans. whether you are a new face to meduli or are quite familiar with what the city has to offer, if you are seeking companionship for the night then there are several establishments that may be worthy of your attention. my first word of advice, before i begin my list, is to avoid the docks outright. i have known several who have visited the courtesans there, only to walk away with an itch or a rash. as one would expect, among the courtesans of meduli you will find a large majority tindremenes, with a small amount of sarducaans and kallards. others are especially rare to find. domina orrine’s domus voluptas the domus voluptas exists as a rather refined institution, directly sanctioned by the provinces. she offers the services of both female and male courtesans and masterfully avoids the “themes” of some other bordellos that some find distasteful, while still establishing a distinct, dark atmosphere that smells rich with spices. as an officially sanctioned bordello, you need not worry about diseases or unwanted pregnancies. the courtesans here are well-educated in the arts, each having an instrument he or she plays. among my favorites were tassa and lander, who will sing and play the lute together when both are available. their coordination and collaboration are masterful in all of their services. anthos apothymion the anthos apothymion, sometimes simply referred to as “the anthos” is a bordello with chiefly female courtesans, with a fitting theme of flowers. the women here each take on the name of a flower and said flower can often be found in their hair or pinned to their clothing. the atmosphere inside is bright, with many windows lining its walls that let in ample sunlight. of my favorite practices of the anthos, it is the ritual of the courtesans giving the patrons of the bordello a flower as they leave that i find the most charming. when i return to my lodging, i need only reach over to my bedside table and inhale deeply to be reminded of the comforting, perfumed embraces of hyacinth, rosa, or paeonia. location: a villa poi between tindrem and the orchard title: n/a text: just like many of the other houses still left vacant from the irruption, this one’s been mostly picked clean of actual valuables. however, the damn bugs left a convenient tunnel for storing things. the group’s split up between the servants’ quarters and the villa. those out in the woods are whining that they want to be in the house, that there are big spiders out there. none they’ve shown me are big as they make them sound. they can wait a week or two. location: fabernum inn, posted outside on its western fence. title: hark! text: you who have found my warning, i beg you do not stay a single night at this inn if you can help it. when i woke this morning and went for my boots, i was shocked by an ugly rat jumping from them and running over my feet! i barefoot chased the thing downstairs and almost crashed straight into the innkeeper, but before i could blurt out the problem at hand i watched as the rat scurried up their leg and into their pocket, only for it to poke its head out, smugly sneering at me with its awful face! i at once demanded an explanation, and it turns out the disgusting vermin is their pet! can you believe it? they just let it run around the inn, who knows where its filthy grubby little appendages have been, other than inside my boots of course. no doubt all the plates and tables are contaminated. if i wanted to be accosted by an animal, i would seek out that deranged sheevra who has been going around asking people if he can inhale their bodily odours most inappropriately. i understanding it is common for alvarin to become intimately fixated on or obsessed with obscure things, but surely this is not something the people should tolerate? i simply cannot stay at such an establishment, and if you have any sense about you, you won't either. fabernum is a strange town. location: fabernum inn, on a table next to the essence artificer. title: today's lament text: my best and most promising apprentice, lost to their own hubris... when i accept eager and spirited scholars under my tutelage and stewardship, it is with the expectation that they enter into this agreement with at minimum the most meager of requisites. firstly, do not waste my time. attend each experiment with a mind open and receptive to learning. second, follow my instructions exactly at all times. i do not offer my valuable time to herd disruptive infants. third, do not touch or move anything on my desk. ever. fourth, do not mishandle an empty essence receptacle, categorically failing to perform a basic extraction and instead end up transposing the empty space within the glass orb with your own liver! sucus, as i sit now in the inn writing this, i have chosen to keep your orb on my desk as a constant and disappointing reminder of the folly of youth. at least the other apprentices will see your curdled blood stuck inside this glass ball and hopefully think twice about being so careless. fret not sucus, you might still be useful yet. location: fab sewer (turn left at the beginning into the dead end) title: strabo text: by the end of this note, you’ll be squinting extra hard. there was some madman who started calling himself “king of the sewers”. he’s probably heard the old story, same as all of us, but we all thought it was funny. until it wasn’t anymore. normally someone like him wouldn’t be a problem, nothing a knife to the throat wouldn’t fix, right? took care of him myself. and then someone else decided they’re the new king! it’s gotten entirely out of hand, they’ve all fallen to the same madness. everyone wants to be king of the sewers, and they don’t last long before someone else kills them and takes their place. oh, and they’re forcing me to write everything for them. you know that old ruin down here, the one you thought might have been huergar stonework that was built over? they’ve decided that’s the ‘castle’. avoid it. location: bakti library title: studies of nature: the celaeno text: page 1/5 this book has been written, edited, and commissioned to be printed by the societas natura myrland, whose headquarters may be found in tindrem. other auxiliary branches include those found in: meduli, headed by marios nearos fabernum, headed by roburo castellina hyllspeia, led by karan obelsyn basilia amata, naturalist and author oyuun, tracker --- page 2/5 by societas natura myrland few creatures strike more immediate fear when speaking their name than that of the celaeno. despite their infamy, however, seldom little is known about these gargantuan creatures of the night. with a great deal of anxiety about my endeavor, i took it upon myself to set out and find this elusive creature. celaenos are nocturnal creatures, and based on information gathered from autopsy, they share similar internal structures to bats. in this sense, the celaeno is to the common bat what the terror bird is to the songbird. a giant, vicious, flightless form. the intelligence of such creatures is of question and great debate. as with any creature that might inspire such fearsome tales, there are stories that would imply them to be highly intelligent beings capable of planning and malice. you may rest easy as it would seem they are nothing of the sort. celaenos are solitary, nocturnal creatures that may be found in caves or other enclosed, dark spaces during the day. it has been observed that they are often near what we naturalists may call a "cauldron" of bats, which is to say a large group of them. --- page 3/5 these cauldrons benefit greatly from the presence of even just one celaeno, though exceptionally large groups of bats may see multiple within the same space. "what role does the celaeno play?" you may wonder. the answer is dragging meat back into the cave for the other bats to eat. while this benefit is surely not one-sided, as the celaeno seem to seek out cauldrons to live amongst, we have yet to uncover the exact benefit. some have some rather outlandish and grotesque theories based on the levels of guano in caves with celaenos in comparison to those without celaenos. the creatures are exceptionally light, likely owing this trait to their shared ancestry with flying creatures. this trait allows them to be talented climbers and to sometimes seem as if they are gliding through the air as if propelled by some unseen force when leaping and lunging. perfectly built for hunting prey in a forest, mountain, or even an open field. --- page 4/5 another phenomenon that may be observed in connection with the celaeno is their participation in the often short- lived 'great cauldrons'. such congregations of many, many chiropterans are not only the stuff of legend: they have also been observed directly. the formation of one requires a very specific set of conditions to take place, including a very large space for the creatures to inhabit, ample food nearby, and insufficient competition to prevent them from starving. these 'great cauldrons' typically break apart once there is a shift in their dynamics, such as an overpopulation of nonreciprocal species that benefit from such colonies. --- page 5/5 though they can be found most anywhere, my own studies centered in the abandoned mines ofthe area south of meduli. with me was oyuun, a gakti khurite tracker and huntsman, who assured me that he had located a nest. oyuun's methods were atypical in comparison to the tindremic hunters i have become so very used to. there is a certain connection to the land that his people have from years ofwanderingthe wilds ofwestern and southern myrland that few can deny. when we reached the area, he instructed me to carefully follow in his footsteps and not make a sound. i must admit that in the dying light of dusk it was quite hard to ascertain where he had stepped. laying down at the very edge of a cliffside, he instructed me to lay my torso on the ground as he did. all we had to do then was be silent, and watch. the scent of some pouch he had opened was offensive to my nose and distracted me a great deal, but he assured me that it was to cover our scent from the creature. long after the sun fell, i saw the silhouettes of both large and small bats flying from the opening to the mineshaft in the moonlight. i could not tell if they were adults and juveniles of the same species or different kinds of bats, but something about the sight sent shivers down my back knowing what would likely emerge soon. location: morin khur ravine - village house title: n/a text: page 1/2 a snake appeared in the village today, it was seen slithering behind the house of the old woman, ekh nogutani. i have done the warding rituals as she khur ravine - village house title: ulagei text: ulagei, when i rest and listen to the sound of the waters being carried to the eastern sea, i hear them whisper to me of a son. a son, ulagei! i know
